The working principle of the traditional malicious data injection attack is to use the limitations of the bad data identification method in the state estimator, maliciously tampering with the measured value of the component, causing the control center to misjudge the current state of the power grid, and then causing the power system stability control measures to malfunction or refuse. This will affect the safe and stable operation of the power system. It can be seen that considering the complexity and importance of system state estimation, in the smart grid environment, analyzing the mechanism of malicious data injection attacks and studying the corresponding detection and prevention methods have very important theoretical and practical significance. Grid planning needs to be optimized urgently, and grid security issues should be taken seriously.

articleTitle: Research on Video Automatic Feature Extraction Technology Based on Deep Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the development of society, people have invested a lot of manpower and material resources in public safety and established various monitoring systems. Video content recognition is to get the theme of video through the analysis of video, and it is an abstract overview of video. Compared with video description and target detection, the results of video content recognition are more concise and abstract, so it can better meet the development needs of information networks with a huge number of videos. Video anomaly detection is to efficiently detect abnormal events from a large number of videos, thus ensuring public safety and preventing dangerous situations. Artificial intelligence system should have the ability to acquire its own knowledge and extract features from the original data. Aiming at the demand of real-time video big data processing ability of video monitoring system, this paper analyzes the automatic video feature extraction technology based on deep neural network, and studies the detection and location of abnormal targets in monitoring video.

articleTitle: A 5G PaaS Collaborative Management and Control Platform Technology Based on Cloud Edge Collaboration Based on Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The traditional cloud computing technology architecture mainly adopts the way of full set for the construction and operation of cloud computing center. With the development of cloud computing technology and the popularization of application, this all centralized mode of cloud computing may not be the optimal solution. Especially in the case of 5g derived vertical business scenarios, for the cloud collaborative management and control platform of power system, the system efficiency of full centralized mode is relatively low. In this paper, through the research on the key technologies of multi form PAAS platform in 5g scenario, the cloud side collaborative 5gpaas power system cloud collaborative management and control platform is realized. The platform is based on cloud native flexible microservice technology components and elastic resource computing, and integrates big data and artificial intelligence platform. This paper constructs a new generation of PAAS platform which is universal in the whole domain, unified in standard, multi cloud collaboration and flexible expansion, and realizes the global cloud, global virtualization and global perceptual construction of cloud collaborative management and control platform under 5g scenario. The platform has a certain reference value for the upgrading of cloud collaborative management and control of power system.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Optimal Load Shedding Based on Thermal Stability Overload of Power System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In recent years, due to continuous increase of load, grid components overload problem caused by weak regional connection is emerging. However, most regional grids have no load shedding solution and related application experience. This paper proposed the strategy, the Principle of Effective Load Shedding and De-sequencing Lines, and overall requirements for load shedding (i.e., N-2 thermal stability overload problem must have 3 rounds of repeated logic judgment independently with different value for each round.) Taking into account the principles of effectiveness and fairness, the first two rounds shedding load alternately according to different faults. In order to prevent ineffective load shedding, the third round of system splitting is designed based on power flow drop ranking in each power grid section as a backup strategy for first two round. Fixed round order and load priority ranking of load shedding are given.

articleTitle: English Teaching Analysis Algorithm Design Based on Bidirectional Association Rules
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: English teaching evaluation is an effective way to evaluate the teaching quality and promote the professional development of English teachers. However, the traditional evaluation of college English teaching is troubled by the randomness and the fuzziness of evaluation criteria of evaluation process. In this paper, with the comprehensive evaluation by a fuzzy-algorithmic approach, a fuzzy comprehensive evaluation model is built on the basis of statistics to provide a scientific basis for teaching evaluation. First, aiming at the characteristics of English teaching, according to the principle and methods of the fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method, with teaching expert, fellow teachers and students as the main body of evaluation and combined with four comprehensive evaluation indicators, the indicator system and the evaluation grade standard of the English teaching evaluation are established. Then the hierarchy analysis method is used to get the weight of each evaluation indicator, and establish the fuzzy comprehensive evaluation model of English teaching.

articleTitle: An Information Retrieval Method Based on Data Key Rules Mining
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: There are rich and complex knowledge networks behind the network big data. The effective use of network big data is the de redundant classification and refinement of data. This paper analyzes and discusses the well-known open network knowledge base at home and abroad and its supporting applications. This paper summarizes the construction of open network knowledge base, the application methods and technologies of information retrieval and data mining based on open network knowledge base, and analyzes the relationship between people and knowledge. This paper solves the matching problem of information retrieval, data mining and system application based on open network knowledge base. Experiments show that the method proposed in this paper has certain reference value to improve the accuracy of information retrieval method.

articleTitle: Design and Research on Distributed Control System of Humanoid Robot Based on Automation Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of science and technology, robots are constantly evolving, and the technology of controlling robots is constantly improving. Humanoid robot is a kind of robot which is similar to human in appearance, and it is an intelligent body with independent decision-making ability, which can cope with the changes of external environment, realize stable walking and carry out human-computer interaction. The requirements of humanoid robot on its structure and control system are different from those of general industrial robots. Because it must be able to walk flexibly, so that it can go to the required place at any time and complete the pre-assigned work. As a complex multi-degree-of-freedom system, humanoid robot needs to effectively use its own multi-sensor information to sense the external environment and its own state changes. In this paper, a distributed control system of humanoid robot is constructed based on the hierarchical control idea of automation technology. It divides the whole control system into main control layer, communication layer and execution layer, which not only enhances the autonomy of execution layer, but also reduces the burden of main control layer, and can prevent abnormal situations.

articleTitle: Analysis on Intelligent Fault Diagnosis Technology of Industrial Control Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Industrial control network is an important part of industrial control system, and its failure has a great impact on normal production. The rapid detection, diagnosis and location of industrial control network fault can improve the robustness and reliability of industrial control network, thus improving the availability of industrial control system. This paper summarizes the difficulties and diagnosis process of industrial control network fault diagnosis. At the same time, it dialectically analyzes the advantages and disadvantages of the existing mainstream diagnosis technology, and puts forward the optimization ideas of industrial control network fault diagnosis technology through comparative analysis.

articleTitle: Fault-Tolerant Routing in DCell Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Data center networks (hereinafter DCNs) have become increasingly crucial to various cloud applications, as the advance of cloud computing. The k-dimensional DCell based on n-port switches (k\geq 0 and n\geq 2),D<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">k,n</sub>, is a suitable DCN with high network capacity. In this paper, we study a fault-free path join any two fault-free different vertices of D<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">k,n</sub> with a faulty vertex set F\subset V(D<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">k,n</sub>) and |F|\leq n+k-2$. Besides, we study the maximal length of the paths, less than or equal to 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">k+1</sup>+3, where it is studied that the diameter of D<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">k,n</sub> has an upper bound 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">k+1</sup>-1. This paper also demonstrates that the fault diameter of D<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">k,n</sub> is less than or equal to 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">k+1</sup>+3. These results are fundamental for fault-tolerant in DCell networks.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Intelligent Teaching System in Colleges and Universities Based on Big Data Application
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Application based on big data, Around the teaching process, a set of intelligent, paperless information and automation efficient and intelligent teaching system is formed for college students from before class to after class. The system analyzed and designed in detail the function of face checking attendance based on artificial intelligence and GPS positioning, the function of fun teaching interaction, the function of intelligent online examination, and the function of automatic intelligent data statistics. It aims to improve teaching efficiency and students' learning initiative, and meet the needs of The Times, society and industry under the new situation of development.

articleTitle: Mixed Sound Event Separation and Recognition Based on VMD-MPE-SVM
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Using sound features to complete the monitoring of automobile engine condition is not only less in operation process and cost, but also less affected by weather and other factors. However, the collected signals will inevitably be polluted by other sounds and become noisy signals, which will affect the output of the research results. Therefore, the purpose of this paper is to extract and identify all kinds of signals in the sound signal, so as to provide effective data for a signal to be used in the acoustic monitoring of engine state. In this paper, VMD algorithm is used to decompose two kinds of recorded mixed sound signals. The number of decomposition layers of the two signals is determined by calculating the mean of center frequency and instantaneous frequency respectively, and multiple intrinsic modal components are obtained. The type of each component is determined by calculating the correlation coefficient method. Then, MPE value was calculated by selecting the appropriate embedded dimension and scale factor by combining MPE. Observe the result of feature extraction. Finally, each component is classified and recognized by SVM, and the experimental results show that the method mentioned in this paper is accurate and effective for separating and recognizing mixed sound event signals.

articleTitle: Proportional Guidance Method and Application of Gravity Compensation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In order to improve the control efficiency of the guidance law of mortar shells, this paper uses Python tools to perform gravity compensation on the traditional proportional guidance method, and designs a PID controller to simulate the control of mortar shells. Monte carlo uncontrolled mortar shells and mortar shells are subjected to simulated target shooting tests, and the circle probability error of the stationary target is calculated, and the control ability is analyzed.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Short Video Recommendation Algorithm Based on Latent Factor Model
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the continuous Internet development, network information amount has increased significantly. In this way, users faced with extensive network information cannot quickly find information that meets their needs, leading to decreased efficiency in network information usage. Accordingly, personalized recommendation system should be an important part of the electronic platform system as recommendation efficiency directly affects the user experience and the use of electronic platforms. In recent years, the data of electronic platforms presents a trend of massive growth, resulting in decreased accuracy in system recommendations, increased errors, and decreased efficiency. Therefore, it is particularly necessary to study and analyze personalized recommendation algorithms. Based on the research and application of latent factor model in short video recommendation algorithm, this paper aims to recommend users with video content that truly meets user needs and interests.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a Timing and Calculating Rings System Based on RFID and WSN
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: This paper proposes a multiple participants based on RFID and WSN middle-long-distance timing problem. The current preliminary 2 nodes in the 400 - meter runway standard setting, cadets read RFID tags to carry through time, with the aid of WSN network, data statistics 3000 meters total has 16. By recording student movement time of each point and the artificial timing results than, the error of the 800 m and 3000 m between 3 to 6 seconds, a fitness test system based on RFID and WSN scheme is used in the sport automatic timing is feasible.

articleTitle: Analysis and Design of Teaching Experiment System Based on Virtual Simulation Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Based on Unity3D platform technology and combined with Firebase RealtimeDatabase database, this paper proposes a set of intelligent teaching experiment system based on virtual simulation technology. This paper analyzes and designs the core technology and system function of virtual simulation. The aim is to completely restore the process and solve various problems existing in the traditional way. It provides a favorable reference for improving teaching quality and building digital teaching platform.

articleTitle: Analysis of Nursing Willingness and Hospice Care Needs of the Elderly in Urban Communities Based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the development of social economy, the age structure of China's population has changed dramatically, which is mainly manifested in the increasing trend of aging. Therefore, it is the focus of aging work to further improve and promote the community service system for the elderly and provide security for the elderly at home, and community nursing service for the elderly is the foundation of the community service system for the elderly. In this paper, genetic algorithm is used to search the nursing wishes and hospice care needs of the elderly in urban communities, and a preliminary nursing wishes and hospice care needs are obtained. Finally, variable neighborhood search is used to optimize hospice care needs. Most employees have a correct understanding of hospice care and support hospice care, but their willingness to engage in hospice care needs to be strengthened. We should strengthen policy support and financial input to hospice care, actively and correctly guide employees, and make medical staff have a scientific understanding of hospice care.

articleTitle: Research on Seawater Laser Communication Channel Based on Visible Light
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In this paper, the optical characteristics of seawater laser communication channel in offshore waters are analyzed, and the transmission process of the seawater channel by Monte Carlo method, we get the statistical chart of the received power under different transmission distances. The results show that the fitting error of circular arc algorithm is less than that of Gaussian function. Based on the circular fitting algorithm, the underwater wireless optical communication channel model is established. According to the transmission model, the relationship among laser transmission distance, arbitrary receiving position and receiving power can be quickly obtained under certain sea water quality parameters, which provides valuable reference for the design of underwater wireless optical communication system.

articleTitle: Design of Dispersive Objective Lens of Spectral Confocal Displacement Sensor
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: According to the working principle of the spectral confocal displacement sensor, four kinds of glass materials SKIO, H-ZLAF52A, N-LAK34 and SFL6 for dispersive lens are selected. 4 single lenses and one doublet lens are components of the initial structure of the linear dispersion objective lens. Optical design software is used to optimize the tolerance of the initial structure of the dispersive objective lens. The results show that the spot diagram of each wavelength is much smaller than the Airy disk. in the wavelength range of 450-700nm, the measurement range of the dispersive objective lens can reach 3.454 mm, and the linear determination coefficient R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> between the axial dispersion diatance and the wavelength is 0.972.

articleTitle: The Multi-micronet Integrated Energy System Based on Multi-target Algorithm optimizes the Scheduling Strategy
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the development of integrated energy system, there are often multiple integrated energy micro networks in the same region, forming an integrated energy system with multiple micro networks. The investment cost and operating cost of system units are often considered by the existing integrated energy system of multiple micro nets, but the problem of environmental pollution is not considered by the integrated energy system of multiple micro nets. Therefore, in order to solve the problem of environmental pollution of diversity micro network integrated energy system and consider the cost of system units, model the integrated energy system of gas turbines, electric chillers and other units respectively and establish the constraints of the system, and then optimize the solution through the particle group algorithm. Finally, through the analysis of the results of the study, in the integrated energy system of multiple micro networks, economic and environmental problems are taken into account at the same time, so that the integrated energy system of multiple micro networks has been improved.

articleTitle: Function Design of College Student Management Information Platform Based on Data Mining Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Data mining technology is a new information processing technology. Its purpose is to extract potential and valuable data rules or data models from massive data. The analysis and processing of college teaching data by data mining technology can form real valuable knowledge, provide information support to decision makers, and promote the all-round development of school teaching reform and construction. In the teaching management of colleges and universities, it is often necessary to deal with a large amount of data. These data relate to the basic situation of teachers, students' basic situation and training plan, curriculum arrangement, performance assessment, teaching evaluation and so on. They have some relations with each other, and some important information is also implied. This paper puts forward a new mode of modern university student management, and designs the function of the information platform for the management of college students. Thus, the purpose of optimizing student management is realized by improving the level of students' scientific research and promoting the development of teaching.

articleTitle: A road extraction algorithm for reducing shadow effect
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The traditional road shadow processing method distinguishes the road from the road shadow, which leads to the reduction of road automation. In this paper, based on the enhancement of the blue component, the brightness component in HSI space is transformed by NDUI shadow exponent transformation, the transformed image is segmented by threshold value, and the road main body is extracted after removing the small area spot and the adaptive structural element morphology closing operation. The test results were evaluated by the detection accuracy and quality, and it was concluded that the detection accuracy of the proposed method in rural roads could reach 96.87% and the detection quality could reach 85.21%. The test results show that this method can effectively eliminate the non-pavement shadow and extract the road with shadow, and has the characteristics of simplicity and high degree of automation.

articleTitle: Research on Design Automatic Illustration Recommendation Method Based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the continuous innovation and development of artificial intelligence, great changes have taken place in various industries relying on high-tech. As an art based on technological invention, illustration is also facing new challenges and opportunities. In the new era of technological innovation and technology application, the future illustration technology will continue to promote intelligent, which indicates that the industry will usher in a new period of transformation and upgrading. At the same time, the quality of illustrations in China and even the world will develop in the direction of high quality and high efficiency. This paper takes the development of artificial intelligence technology in the new era as the research starting point, maps the image features with the subjective style discrimination ability features, and then according to the demand, the illustration recommendation method based on the optimization processing model is used to carry out the illustration recommendation, and the pre recommendation results are obtained. Finally, the final illustration recommendation is obtained by optimizing the pre recommendation results through the user feedback algorithm oriented to the illustration recommendation result. We compare the performance of the proposed method with the two linear models based on SVM, and find that the proposed model can better recommend illustrations for users.

articleTitle: Credibility of Browser Extension Program Based on Behavioral Statement
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: As users have increasing demand for communication at anytime and anywhere, browser plays an increasingly greater role in the Internet, with browser extension program more widely used. However, problem regarding credibility of browser extension program has also arisen. This paper proposes a method to automatically acquire the behavior and actions of extension program during the browser running phase. In this method, a series of user behaviors will be simulated to maximize the exposure of behaviors and actions by the extension, thus collecting the API calling information of browser extension program as comprehensively as possible. According to the acquired browser extension, API information is called to plot the browser extension behavior diagram. Malicious extension and non-malicious extension behavior diagram are compared to infer the malicious behavior calling sequence, thus declaring the untrusted behavior model. Finally, through experiments, feasibility of this method is verified.

articleTitle: Optimization for Satellite Navigation System Level Parameter Modelling Based on Artificial Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: BP algorithm is a common method to correct satellite navigation system level parameter modelling, which can significantly improve the accuracy of the measurement results. However, the traditional BP algorithm is easy to fall into local minimum, which makes the accuracy and stability of the measurement results poor. In this paper, an optimization algorithm based on immune algorithm and BP neural network is proposed. The global search is carried out by using the immune algorithm, and then the BP algorithm is used for local search. The experimental results show that the optimization algorithm can effectively avoid the traditional BP algorithm falling into local minimum when training multi-layer forward neural network, and has the merits of high prediction precision, rapid convergence, global superiority and accuracy for optimization. The measurement accuracy is improved. Moreover, the mean square error between the satellite navigation system height fitting error and the standard value of the neural network is less than 0.0422, the average error is less than 0.0466 and the maximum relative error is less than 0.0496.

articleTitle: The Application of Computer Music Technology in Music Education
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of Internet technology, computers are widely used in all walks of life, and among them, computer music technology has become one of the important tools in modern music education. Analysis of the traditional music teaching mode can be found, most of the time is limited to the teacher performance, student imitation, however, for the new era of music education, the combination of computer technology and music knowledge has brought great convenience for the development of music education, not only enrich the content of music teaching, but also make some abstract music theory knowledge become more vivid image, more to a certain extent, broaden the students' musical horizons, this, in the actual music teaching teachers should pay great attention to. This paper has done an in-depth study on this, firstly introducing the characteristics of computer music technology, analyzing the advantages of computer music technology in music education, and then discussing the practical application of computer music technology in music education with the actual situation.

articleTitle: Research on Performance Evaluation Algorithm of Public Administration Department Based on Simulated Annealing Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Since the reform and opening up, in order to adapt to the development of socialist market economy, China has continuously improved the government performance evaluation, actively carried out the pilot and exploration of government performance evaluation, accumulated valuable experience and achieved remarkable results. The weight of traditional departmental performance appraisal is subjective, which is not very reasonable for departmental performance appraisal, especially for non-profit departments such as public administration departments. Because the public administration department has different characteristics from the private sector, it is very difficult to accurately evaluate its performance. Without a scientific evaluation dimension, the evaluation will be disastrous. In order to overcome the subjectivity of evaluation weight in the traditional department performance evaluation, this paper discusses the impact of the new public management movement on the performance evaluation of the public sector, and innovatively puts forward the performance evaluation method of public management department based on simulated annealing algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on Cloud Parking System Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the development of social networking, the focus of people's production and life has gradually shifted to the network. At the same time, the development of social economy is also showing high speed, people's living standards have also changed significantly. As an important means of transportation for people's daily travel, vehicles are more and more popular, and the number of vehicles in the city is also increasing. This phenomenon is particularly prominent in the first and second tier cities. The contradiction between the limited parking space and the sharp increase of vehicles is gradually highlighted. Based on the application research of big data technology in the parking system, the parking information is collected through a large number of parking data in the cloud, and then the data is classified and analyzed by using data mining algorithm. It can realize the reservation of parking and reasonable planning of routes, and provide scientific services for car owners according to the habits of car owners, so as to improve people's travel satisfaction to a greater extent.

articleTitle: Research on Big Data Encryption Algorithm Based on Data Redundancy Elimination Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In the privacy encryption of big data classification, the traditional encryption method based on chaos theory simply regards chaotic sequence as a key without secondary encryption process, which reduces the security of the key and the effectiveness of encryption. This paper discusses the principle of data privacy encryption algorithm in big data environment and the optimization of data privacy encryption algorithm. The message redundancy is dynamically adjusted by using the expected probability of successful transmission of messages to sink and the current opportunity probability of nodes, so that the lower the opportunity probability of forwarding messages, the higher the forwarding redundancy, and the clustering of redundant features of large data sets is realized. Experimental results show that the proposed algorithm has high performance of eliminating redundant data, and the clustering effect of big data under this algorithm is excellent, with high balance.

articleTitle: Research and Practice of Basic Programming Course
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: A new researching and teaching project of basic programming was proposed and carried out for freshmen of computer science and software engineering including the refinement of training objective, the adjustment of course schedule, the argumentation of course content, the extension of practice training, the establishment of the evaluation system and the assessment index and the aggrandizement of the usage of online practice platform and online judge platform. Finally, the effectiveness of the project proposed in this paper is validated through the case study.

articleTitle: Web Application Software Engineering Technology and Process
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of network technology and the rapid growth of e-commerce, complex wide-area distributed Web applications are emerging. Many traditional information management and database systems are being migrated to the Internet. The development of Web engineering is increasing gradually, and the proportion in software engineering technology and project development process will be larger and larger. Web engineering is an emerging and rapidly developing discipline. In order to ensure that Web engineering can develop as efficiently as traditional software engineering so as to avoid Web crisis, this paper will illustrate with the development and process examples of Web engineering technology. Combined with the software development and project management process and related results of a Web engineering project example, namely the driver training management information system (JPMIS), this paper proposes some applications based on the Web engineering software development and project management technology. This paper puts forward a concrete implementation method for the application of Web engineering in China's small and medium-sized software enterprises.

articleTitle: A New Method of Continuous Power Flow for Voltage Stability Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Continuous power flow is an important method for solving voltage stability. This paper proposes a continuous power flow method combined with improved prediction-correction. It uses the fast convergence characteristics of the improved Newton iterative format to iterate. In parameterization this method combines the advantages of physical parameterization and local parameterization in different regions. In step size control, the variable step size control function is proposed. Finally, through examples, the effectiveness of the method in this paper is verified, and the effectiveness of the continuous power flow method in analyzing voltage stability is improved.

articleTitle: Application of Image Recognition Technology Based on Artificial Intelligence in Operation Control of Production Domain
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The application of image processing technology and intelligent recognition technology in power equipment image recognition and analysis is a new method to monitor the operation status of power equipment. Especially in the high voltage, dangerous and harsh environment, it can obtain the operation status of power equipment in real time. At the same time, this method can reduce the workload of dispatchers and improve the automation degree of on-line monitoring. In this paper, a set of image processing and recognition methods for fault detection are proposed, in which the maximum inter class variance method selection threshold, sequential similarity method identification, frame difference method judgment and other methods are used for on-line monitoring of power equipment, which replaces the traditional manual inspection and improves the efficiency. The experimental results show that this image recognition method integrates the advantages of various technologies, and the processing results are more accurate.

articleTitle: Posterior Probability-Based Single Time-Series Model Combination Strategy for Predicting Multi-Temporal Crop Classification
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Currently, with the rapid development of remote sensing, the timely and accurate estimation of crop yield based on remote sensing is of great significance for scientific and practical purposes. Different from previous years, crop yield estimation is conducted every month in actual agricultural insurance nowadays. Crop yield estimation needs to be provided in a timely and accurate manner. It is a key issue to use multitemporal remote sensing data effectively and flexibly. With the development of remote sensing and computer science, state-of the-art research on crop yield estimation has shifted from relying on a single static state to a combination of multiple spectral and time-series information. We propose a method to divide multispectral data into a single time phase in deep learning and then combine the information of the multitemporal results on each neural network model. This can maintain the accuracy of the original information although the remote sensing multi-time series data is missing in some time phases. However, in actual practice, more accurate results can be further obtained with the superposition of new time-series data. We trained several semantic segmentation models for each individual time-series dataset. On the single time phase model, the accuracy of rice classification, corn classification and forest classification were 85.9%-92.8%, 77%-93% and 77%-87.6% respectively. Furthermore, the classification accuracy of our method for all catalogs reached 92.6% by the multi-temporal verification dataset from May to September of 2017. The finding of our approach can be applied to the continuous iteration of agricultural yield estimation in agricultural insurance and crop growth change monitoring in big agricultural areas.

articleTitle: FPGA Implementation of HoG-based Space Target Distance Measurement
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: This paper focuses on space cooperative target identification and ranging using monocular CMV4000 CMOS sensor and Xilinx Zynq-7000 Soc based platform without the operating system that adopts Histograms of Oriented Gradients (HOG) descriptor and Support Vector Machine (SVM) for classification. With Vivado High-Level Synthesis to accelerate IF creation by enabling C specifications to be directly targeted into devices, this implementation allows for two high-resolution images (2048×2048 pixels) processing per second. The hardware and software co-design of Xilinx Zynq7000 promises the accuracy of space target classification and distance measurement and thus meets the requirement of realtime space application.

articleTitle: Information Security Protection of Power System Computer Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the reform of the power market(PM), various power applications based on computer networks have also developed. As a network application system supporting the operation of the PM, the technical support system(TSS) of the PM has become increasingly important for its network information security(NIS). The purpose of this article is to study the security protection of computer network information in power systems. This paper proposes an identity authentication algorithm based on digital signatures to verify the legitimacy of system user identities; on the basis of PMI, according to the characteristics of PM access control, a role-based access control model with time and space constraints is proposed, and a role-based access control model is designed. The access control algorithm based on the attribute certificate is used to manage the user's authority. Finally, according to the characteristics of the electricity market data, the data security transmission algorithm is designed and the feasibility is verified. This paper presents the supporting platform for the security test and evaluation of the network information system, and designs the subsystem and its architecture of the security situation assessment (TSSA) and prediction, and then designs the key technologies in this process in detail. This paper implements the subsystem of security situation assessment and prediction, and uses this subsystem to combine with other subsystems in the support platform to perform experiments, and finally adopts multiple manifestations, and the trend of the system's security status the graph is presented to users intuitively. Experimental studies have shown that the residual risks in the power system after implementing risk measures in virtual mode can reduce the risk value of the power system to a fairly low level by implementing only three reinforcement schemes.

articleTitle: Construction of Live Animation Platform Based on Motion Capture Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Based on the inertial action capture technology, this paper applies the human body natural performance action to control the virtual character synchronously, and realizes the establishment of real-time animation creation and live broadcast platform by using the virtual animation character as the real person substitute. In the scheme, the action capture technology is applied to solve the animation control problem by manipulating the action of the animated character (virtual character) in real time by the performer (real character), and the real-time rendering technology of the game engine is applied to solve the real-time rendering problem. Real-time animation creation and live broadcast function.

articleTitle: Characteristics Simulation of Axial Pump Based on AMESim
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In order to study the performance of axial plunger pump, the equation of piston motion was deduced. The AMESim model of piston pump was created with the structure parameter of one certain domestic piston pump and the characteristics were studied. The pressure and flow characteristic were analysesed, and the results of simulation analysis in this paper will provide a theoretical foundation for optimization design of the pump.

articleTitle: Pneumatic Training Glove Based on Electromyographic Signal Control
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In modern society, much public attention is paid to the rights and interests of the disabled, which become a social problem. In order to satisfy the pursuit of disabled for a better quality of life, it is necessary to give them a normal life. For example, people with degeneration or atrophy of hand muscles caused by accidents or other reasons need an auxiliary system to help them recover their hand muscles. However, after consulting a large amount of data, I found that most hospitals in the market use hard levers and springs as mechanical structures, which will result in excessive resistance, poor finger curls, and even aggravate the disease due to improper use. In contrast, the deformable structure is softer. Meanwhile, it can actively bend the fingers of patient through the inflation control method to achieve the purpose of safety and effectiveness. In this paper, the design and casting of pneumatic muscle are completed through independent modeling and pouring in the experiment [1]. At the same time, this paper also provides and tests two machine learning pneumatic muscle control algorithms based on real-time binning, which are idempotent and real-time, and can be fully controlled in combination with the designed pneumatic muscle. Its core signal comes from EMG signals on key muscle groups of the arm. The signal is collected from muscle in real time by wet electrode patch. For the control model of machine learning, we have tested and implemented a variety of gesture postures, including common palm curling and stretching, common finger movements, etc. The pneumatic muscle hand rehabilitation auxiliary glove based on electromyographic signal control has the characteristics such as passive exercise, safety, less pain, individuation, low price, full and effective exercise, etc. The pneumatic muscle-assisted rehabilitation system based on electrical signal control in this paper has broad application prospects and extremely high value.

articleTitle: Risk assessment and emergency response of limited power space operation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In order to reduce the operation risks in limited power space and improve the effectiveness of emergency response and rescue of accidents, various risks in the typical limited space of the power industry and the current problems in emergency response are analyzed. The risks in the limited power space can be divided into two types, including objective risks and subjective risks caused by workers during operation. In the emergency process, key improvements should be made in terms of on-site plans, personnel capabilities, rescue equipment, and linkage mechanisms to reduce casualties and property losses.

articleTitle: Research on Food Safety and Hygiene Based on Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In recent years, food safety and sanitation issues have occurred frequently in our country. Food sanitation and safety issues have always been the most concerned issues of all sectors of society, and they are an important aspect that the country must do well in management and control. Based on the current research status of food safety and sanitation in my country, this paper uses the colony algorithm to identify food safety and sanitation, so as to develop a good early warning identification system. This paper proposes an improved colony optimization algorithm to solve the problem of PID parameter tuning prematurely converging into an invalid algorithm. In order to solve the problem of colony letter number extraction, an image-based colony extraction algorithm is proposed. In order to overcome the shortcomings of poor generality of multi-scale colony segmentation, a colony optimization calculation method based on improved level sets is proposed. Experimental research results show that by establishing an optimization mechanism for bacterial colony formation and death, the optimization algorithm can provide a new path at the end. It is used to solve food safety and health problems in real life. During the experiment, I learned that the algorithm has good practicability and adaptability, and fully verified the practical significance of the model.

articleTitle: Automatic Generation Method of Multimedia Animation Image Based on Surface Mosaic
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of poor image effect in traditional image automatic generation technology, this paper proposes an automatic generation method of multimedia animation image based on surface stitching. Firstly, the principle of surface stitching is analyzed. On this basis, the feature vectors in the acquired image basic information are matched. According to the matching process, the camera is positioned by using the initial position calibration method, and the pose offset parameters are obtained. The mutual information between the collected image information and the generated image is taken as the similarity measure, and the spatial transformation parameters of the surface image to be registered are obtained Finally, the automatic generation of multimedia animation image is realized. The experimental results show that the matching degree of feature points is more than 87%, the image accuracy is up to 90%, and the average time consumption is 167s, which has good performance.

articleTitle: Research and Exploration on Voltage Detection Technology for Electricity Stealing and Omission
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Under the background of sustainable development, more and more countries begin to study and use renewable new energy. Photovoltaic power generation is one of the research hotspots at present. The construction of a safe, reliable and economical photovoltaic power station monitoring system is of great significance to the development of intelligent information management of power system. In order to guarantee the normal operation of distributed photovoltaic power station, it is especially important to design a integrated monitoring system. A distributed photovoltaic power station leakage monitoring system based on power line communication is proposed in this paper, which can effectively monitor the leakage current of distributed photovoltaic power station. This system improves the automation ability and efficiency of the power station. In this paper, the voltage detection technology of power theft and leakage is studied. Through experimental research, the factors causing the instability and low precision of the sensor are found. In view of the shortcomings of Hall current sensor, the corresponding improvement is made through experimental research, so that the temperature drift problem is greatly improved and the measurement accuracy is further improved. The design scheme of the whole circuit system is optimized to best satisfy the requirements of precision and stability of the monitoring system.

Author Keywords: Technology of electric theft and leakage

articleTitle: Probe into the Digital Protection of Qinghai Intangible Cultural Heritage by Library Based on New Media Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Intangible cultural heritage is the crystallization of human wisdom in long-term practice, and is a precious cultural resource of the nation. The emergence of new media technology provides the possibility for the digital display of intangible cultural heritage, and promotes the development and inheritance of intangible cultural heritage. Intangible heritage culture is an excellent and splendid traditional culture of the Chinese nation, which needs to be continuously inherited and carried forward. The application of new media technology provides innovative ways and channels for the digital display of intangible culture. The information age has brought opportunities to the protection of intangible cultural heritage in Qinghai Province. Many traditional arts and cultures can not be effectively preserved because of the limitations of communication methods. Therefore, intangible cultural heritage should also be digitally improved with the help of modern library platform. In view of the present situation of non-genetic heritage protection in Qinghai Province, this paper explores the inheritance and protection strategies of Qinghai intangible cultural heritage based on the digital platform of the library, and through the application of Internet and digital technology, so as to give full play to the intangible historical, artistic and educational value of Qinghai.

articleTitle: The Monitoring and Early Warning System of Geological Disaster Mass Survey and Prevention in Linzhi
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Based on Beidou satellite navigation and communication technology, this paper develops a monitoring and early warning system for geological disaster mass survey and prevention, aiming at the problems of great harminess and difficulty in monitoring geological disasters in Linzhi. The whole system is constructed using B/S architecture. The server is developed by Asp.Net language, the client is developed by HTML5, CSS, JavaScript and other technologies. The data transmission between the client and server is realized by Ajax technology. The client includes two parts: web-end and app-end, which are respectively developed by layui and uniapp framework. The app-end determines the disaster location and reports the scene pictures based on the Beidou satellite navigation technology (BDS), and then transmits the collected disaster data to the platform with the help of the 4G or 5G network. The administrator pushes the reviewed disaster information to the public through the audit and intelligent analysis of the disaster data. This system has been tested in Linzhi, and the results show the system can effectively assist the mass survey and prevention work.

articleTitle: Design and Realization of Monitoring and Management System of Large-Scale Watercraft
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Monitoring and management system of large-sized watercraft is a non-linear complex system with many parameter. Monitoring and management system of large-sized watercraft based on networks is different from other conventional system, its basic idea is: at first large-sized watercraft is divdied into many multi-layer subsystem, computation of every rock-bottom system is finished by networks, and then give effect level of every factor, and then the effect level is taked as input value of the previous subsystem, after neural computation, and we can know evaluation of the previous subsystem of the subsystem, analogy according to this until we give evaluation of the large-sized watercraft. Experiment data and result is the same as the reslult the system give. Knowledge library of the system is easy to renew and maintain, and enhance self-learning ability of the system, and avoid the problem of “knowlegye explosion” in conventional expert system.

articleTitle: Wireless Mesh Video Based on Neural Network in Cloud Edge Collaborative Management and Control Software
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In the cloud edge collaborative management and control software, due to the large amount of wireless mesh video data and high requirements for real-time, packet loss is easy to occur in the transmission process. How to improve the transmission reliability of wireless mesh video has always been a research hotspot. Aiming at the problem that the reliability of data transmission in cloud edge collaborative management and control software is not high, this paper proposes a wireless mesh network load balancing protocol NNP based on neural network prediction model_L2MPM. The protocol takes the length of MAC interface queue as the measure of traffic load, and then uses RBF neural network prediction model to predict the traffic load of nodes in mesh network. In order to avoid the congestion in the next time, we can improve the performance of the network according to the load of the next node. The simulation results show that: the protocol uses RBF neural network prediction model to achieve the node traffic load prediction, and then achieves load balancing. Experiments show that nnp-l2mpm protocol has good performance.

articleTitle: Low-Cost Circuit Design for EEG Signal Amplification and Extraction
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: EEG (electroencephalogram) signal is an important biological signal, for it contains large amounts of biological electric information in human body. EEG has a large amount of applications covering wide areas, including adjuvant therapy, cognitive processes, brain disease diagnosis, rehabilitation medicine and military fields. With the improvement of signal process technology and integrated circuit design, the project acquiring EEG signal to analyze drain's information has been widely researched. This paper invented a low-cost circuit to detect EEG signal in BCI (brain computer interface) system. The low-cost circuit adopts the resistance capacitance coupled circuit, active shield driver and floating power supply, which has strong anti-interference ability and simple structure. This circuit is able to amplify the weak EEG signal precisely and filter the noise effectively. The simulation results proved the effectiveness of this method for EEG signal amplification, suppressing noise and extraction of low-frequency signal.

articleTitle: Analysis on R&D Short Board of Resource-based Cities in the Yellow River Basin Based on RBF Neural Network Model
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Yulin is a typical resource-based city in the Yellow River Basin. In this paper, the research and development activities and investment status of Yulin science and technology, through the learning of neural RBF neural network model, and in-depth comparative analysis with some cities inside and outside the province, summed up the common problems of R&D investment in resource-based cities in the Yellow River Basin, and put forward the reasonable construction of R&D investment in resource-based cities from the aspects of financial support, scientific research institute cultivation, personnel training, etc Discussion.

articleTitle: Design and Research of a Nonlinear Distortion Three-stage Coupling Amplifier
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In applications, the nonlinear characteristics of transistor, unreasonable setting of static operating point or excessive signal input often lead to the amplifier working in the nonlinear region, resulting in waveform distortion. In this paper, a three-stage coupled amplifier with nonlinear distortion is designed. The original signal is amplified by two-stage emitter bias amplifier circuit and a class B single-source complementary symmetrical power amplifier. The first stage realizes signal amplification. The top distortion, bottom distortion and bidirectional waveform output are realized by adjusting the base divider resistance and emitter resistance of the second stage. In the third stage, the short-circuit diode of relay is used to realize the output of cross distortion waveform. The control end uses stm32f4 as the main control chip, keyboard as the input module, LCD as the display module, the control end outputs the amplitude on the display screen through AD sampling, and uses fast Fourier transform (FFT) to calculate the total harmonic distortion (THD), which is verified to have high accuracy.

articleTitle: The Use of Stereoscopic Display Technology under Human-computer Interaction in Navigation Simulator
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: To study the stereoscopic display technology and its specific implementation process in the human-computer interaction (HCI) simulation system, and enhance the sense of reality and immersion in the simulation training, in this exploration, using the digital modeling of virtual reality (VR) technology for stereoscopic display simulation is proposed. By using the corresponding relationship between virtual camera and human eye, the stereoscopic display system and human-computer interactive stereoscopic display navigation simulator system are designed. First, the stereoscopic display technology and principle are analyzed, and its specific way is explained. Then, the image processing process and image rendering process in the stereoscopic display system are studied. Moreover, the modeling process and interactive process in the human-computer interactive stereoscopic display system are explored. Finally, the stereoscopic display system and HCI are tested. The results show that the projection generated by off-axis model has no y-axis offset and no vertical parallax, and its field of view is the largest. When the distance between virtual cameras is 0.005, the fusion of two images is the most stereoscopic and realistic.

articleTitle: Strength Analysis of High Loaded Electronic Equipment Shelter Based on Finite Element Method
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The electronic equipment Shelters will be subjected to a large number of equipment, resulting in high and uneven loading of Shelter. It is necessary to consider whether the strength and stiffness of the structure of Shelter meet the design requirements. In this study, the finite element models of Shelter with different working conditions are built based on finite element method. Simulations of strength and stiffness of structure are carried out, and the results show that the structure performances of the electronic equipment Shelter can satisfy the design requirements. This study can provide a theoretical reference for the products development of the high loaded Shelter.

articleTitle: Analysis of Cloud Computing Security Based on SGX Enhanced National Secret Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The operation security of national secret algorithm is an important research issue in the field of cloud computing security. This paper studies and proposes a cloud computing security operation scheme for SGX enhanced national security algorithm. Based on the analysis of SGX technology and national security enhanced algorithm, the cloud computing environment for SGX enhanced national security algorithm is constructed. The accuracy rate of SM3 algorithm and HMAC algorithm for SM3 is 100%, both of which can calculate the hash value correctly. When the algorithm runs 800 times, the overall running time of the original SM3 algorithm, the running time of the enhanced SM3 algorithm itself, the running time of the enhanced SM3 initialize Enclave, and the overall running time of the enhanced SM3 algorithm are about 0.1s, 0.5s, 14s, 15s, respectively.

articleTitle: The Human-Computer Interaction Online Oral English Teaching Mode Based on Moodle Platform
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: This paper focuses on the study of human-computer interaction online oral English teaching mode based on Moodle platform. The research targets are the two classes of art students from the integrated model of international cooperative education in the author's university. Before the experiment, the students are divided into experimented class and controlled class. The college students' online oral English practice is established based on the Moodle platform. The experimental class have the access to use this platform to practice their oral English, but the controlled class just use the traditional way to study and practice. The experiment result shows that the experimented class students are interested in the human-computer interaction online oral English and have improved their oral English greatly.

articleTitle: Research on the special chiller for semiconductor industry based on fuzzy PID control
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In semiconductor integrated circuit manufacturing, lithography, etching, physical vapor deposition, chemical vapor deposition and other processes, which need to use chiller for precise temperature control of process chamber. The special chiller for semiconductor industry is used to meet the process requirements of large load change and precise temperature control. The special chiller for semiconductor industry is composed of refrigeration system and circulation system. The refrigeration system includes four main parts: compressor, condenser, electronic expansion valve and evaporator, the circulation system is composed of water tank, circulating pump and heater. The system of chiller is a multivariable, nonlinear and time-varying complex system. The temperature control of chiller is affected by compressor frequency, evaporating pressure, suction pressure, heating power and other parameters, it is difficult to establish a mathematical model accurately. The traditional PID control is difficult to meet the control needs. Therefore, fuzzy PID control is adopted. Fuzzy control is applied to improve the system response when the system error is larger, and conventional PID regulator is used when the system error is smaller. The parameters of PID control are changed by using the idea of fuzzy PID, and PID control action is adjusted according to different error situation and control cycle, thereby, reasonable control and regulation of temperature are achieved.

articleTitle: Performance Test of Digital Chip Based on LK8810 Platform
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In recent years, integrated circuit industry has become the core and pillar of China's information industry. Integrated circuit is a technology intensive industry with a long industrial chain, which mainly includes four links: integrated circuit design, chip manufacturing, chip packaging and chip testing. With the rapid development of integrated circuit technology, the degree of chip integration is getting higher and higher. High integrated digital chips need higher requirements of test technology, in order to improve the test accuracy and help the chip qualification detection. Based on LK8810 integrated circuit tester, taking SN74LS08 digital chip as an example, this paper tests the digital chip from three aspects: open and short circuit test, function test and parameter test, makes a comprehensive research on the chip performance, and analyzes the functional characteristics and key parameters of the chip. In the implementation of the test, the hardware and software joint debugging is carried out from the aspects of hardware circuit design and implementation, software test combination optimization, and finally the chip test results are displayed by the upper computer of the platform. After strict comparison and analysis with the example digital chip data manual, as well as comprehensive analysis and exploration, the results show that the test effectively improves the accuracy of digital chip test. The digital chip test scheme is simple and feasible, accurate and intuitive, which is suitable for the test of various digital chip functions and parameters.

articleTitle: Research on Integer Ambiguity Algorithm of GNSS under Different Monitoring Modes
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: According to the different requirements of GNSS deformation monitoring in terms of time and accuracy, based on the traditional periodic repeated monitoring mode, two GNSS monitoring modes, fixed continuous monitoring mode and real-time dynamic monitoring mode, are adopted, and the corresponding double difference integer ambiguity processing algorithm is mainly studied, so as to form a GNSS model to meet the monitoring requirements of different accuracy levels and time resolution, and through the analysis of examples to verify the correctness of the two methods.

articleTitle: Research on Data Fusion Method Based on Real-time Analysis of Dynamic Traffic Flow
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: This In view of the current status of the expressway data acquisition system and future expectations, three data fusion methods are designed in this paper: Method 1 requires more cross-section flow detection data to estimate and correct the dynamic OD matrix, which can theoretically achieve accurate estimation and real-time prediction of the traffic state of the road network. However, many expressway networks do not yet fully meet such conditions, so the second method is proposed. In addition to inputting real-time toll record data, Method 2 only needs to be able to monitor the up and down ratios of vehicles entering the toll station and the turning ratio of vehicles on the entrance of the interchange. Therefore, the number of detection stations required by method 2 is greatly reduced compared with the first method. In view of the situation that there are no cross-section monitoring points in the road network, method 3 proposed in this paper only needs to input real-time toll record data. Regarding the reality of the current data collection system of the current expressway network, only the third data fusion method can be applied at present.

articleTitle: High-Precision Sub-Pixel Displacement Algorithm Based on Temporal Sequence Digital Images
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Digital image correlation algorithm (DIC) has the advantages of non-contact, full-field measurement, and easy automation. The previous sub-pixel positioning algorithms for temporal sequence digital images used the entire pixel displacement as the initial value of the fitting. When the displacement between consecutive multiple frames of images is small (less than 1 pixel), the fitting part of the sub-pixel will produce a larger To solve this problem, this article proposes a high-precision sub-pixel displacement algorithm based on time-series digital images. First, the entire pixel displacement is calculated by the particle swarm algorithm, and then the subpixel displacement is calculated using the bicubic interpolation algorithm, and finally the moving least square is used. The multiplication fits the sub-pixel displacement solved in the previous step on the time axis, and a high-precision sub-pixel displacement is obtained. At the end of the article, ANSYS was used to simulate the tensile experiment of duralumin, and 100 speckle images were simulated by Matlab to verify the effectiveness of the method. The experimental results show that the accuracy of the method can reach 0.01-0.03pixel, the mean error is 0.00263, and the standard deviation is 0.00222.

articleTitle: Analysis on solid protection system of industrial control network security in intelligent factory
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: This paper focuses on the typical business scenario of intelligent factory, it includes the manufacturing process, carries out hierarchical security protection, forms a full coverage industrial control security protection network, completes multi-means industrial control security direct protection, at the same time, it utilizes big data analysis, dynamically analyzes the network security situation, completes security early warning, realizes indirect protection, and finally builds a self sensing and self-adjusting industrial network security protection system It provides a reliable reference for the development of intelligent manufacturing industry.

Author Keywords: Intelligent manufacturing industrial control network industrial control security

articleTitle: Development of Tourism Economy in Jiangxi Province Based on Multiple Regression Model
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In recent years, Jiangxi Province's tourism service trade has developed rapidly and played an obvious role in promoting the economy. In order to deeply study the problems existing in the tourism industry of the province and promote the sound and rapid development of the tourism industry Eviews9.0 software is used to make a quantitative analysis of the multiple linear regression model based on the data from 1995 to 2018. Some problems existing in the development of tourism industry in Jiangxi Province are pointed out some problems existing in the development of tourism industry in Jiangxi Province, and some feasible suggestions are given on the development of tourism industry.

articleTitle: A 14-bit 75-Msample/s Pipelined ADC
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: A 14-bit 75MS/s pipelined analog-to-digital converter (ADC) implemented in a 0.18μm CMOS process is presented in this paper. SHA-less and amplifier sharing technique is used to reduce overall power consumption and area. The calibration free ADC achieves 67.9dBFS SNR and 82.2dBFS SFDR with a 70MHz sine input. It consumes 322mW under 3.3V supply.

articleTitle: A Parameterized 3D Layout Design Method for Satellite
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Satellites equipment three-dimensional (3D) layout design is based on 2D schematic drawings and files. It leads to a problem that extracting input data and creating the assembly constraints in the 3D environment bring a large workload, meanwhile the layout result couldn't build a direct relationship with the input data automatically. A layout method driven by parameterized data is proposed in this study. By the means of model-based definition (MBD) and CATIA development, rapid design from the electrical schematic of the satellite to 3D layout is realized. Firstly, the input data are parameterized to XML format. And then, parsing the information of XML in by CATIA interface, the 3D model of equipment in server can be loaded automatically in CATIA workspace and the electrical connection of equipment can be displayed visually. Then using the algorithm of cabin surface capture we developed, equipment can capture the cabin surface intelligently and the assembly constraint can be created automatically. This method can realize the direct mapping of the input data to the satellite equipment 3D layout design. Meanwhile, the real-time update of layout status can realize the review of the design integrity, which can decrease some checking labor. Finally, this method is applied to a typical satellite equipment 3D layout design, and the result shows that it can effectively improve the automation and efficiency of the design.

articleTitle: Research on Dynamic Interaction Mechanism of Power Distribution Information Physical System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In the field of distribution network, through the construction and promotion of intelligent distribution network, information and communication systems such as distribution automation and electricity consumption information acquisition system are gradually popularized in the distribution network. Photovoltaic, wind power and other distributed energy or electricity based on flexible control The equipment further strengthens the controllability of the distribution network and its dependence on the information control system, and deeply interconnects the two physical networks of the distribution network and the information communication network, so that the primary system and the secondary system in the distribution network are coupled, Close contact.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction of Integrated Management Information System for E-commerce Enterprises Based on Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The industrialization of enterprise information application is an important development trend in the field of enterprise informationization. Constructing the reference model of enterprise engineering enterprise integration for specific industries can improve the implementation speed and quality of enterprise informatization. Collaborative ecommerce breaks the old management mode and fully embodies the core idea of management integration. With the arrival of the cloud era, e-commerce business activities have broken through the limitation of time and space and improved efficiency. However, under the background of cloud computing, there are still some problems in the management mode of ecommerce enterprises, which can not ensure the perfection of the relevant management mode, and it is difficult to effectively manage the cost, technology and security. In the absence of a perfect management model, it is impossible to ensure the reasonable implementation of all aspects of management in ecommerce enterprises, which seriously affects their long-term development. This paper discusses the development requirements of e-commerce, discusses the functional requirements of e-commerce for enterprise management information system integration and the construction method of integrated enterprise management information system based on cloud computing.

articleTitle: Research on Potential Attack Detection Method of Information Transmission Network Based on LSTM
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of information technology, the concept of information security is gradually gaining popularity. In order to better protect the user information and improve the security of the system, the potential attack detection method test technology LSTM potential Attack Detectione into being. In short, the potential attack detection method test is to simulate the hacker's technical means to detect the security of the system. In this paper, the LSTM-based framework for testing potential attack detection methods in information transmission networks is selected as the platform.
