The methodology for testing potential attack detection methods is used to define a series of rules, practices, processes and methods that should be referenced and followed in any information security audit. At present, in order to meet the needs of security assessment, many potential attack detection methods have been developed to test method rate. The cumulative factor changes with time, reaches the lower bound at time T1, and then reduces the value of LSTM by one; reaches the upper bound at time T2, and then increases the value of LSTM by one. At either Time T1 or T2, the value of the cumulative factor after LSTM adjustment becomes 0. When the cumulative factor reaches the upper or lower bound, it will trigger the LSTM adjustment or the number of repetitions will reach the upper bound at time T2, and then the LSTM value will be increased by one. Whether at time T1 or T2, the rate of cumulative factor after LSTM adjustment.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Electronic Control Unit in Automatic Control System of Locking Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to research on the design and implementation of electronic control unit in automatic control system of locking mechanism. The hardware circuit of the locking mechanism should complete the shaping and filtering of various input signals, and provide the operation platform for the control software. At the same time, it is necessary to generate control signal and amplify its power, as well as necessary communication interface. In this paper, according to the function and performance requirements of the automatic control system of the differential locking mechanism, and combined with the needs of the general electronic control system, the hardware and software of the locking mechanism are designed. The experiment shows that the design of hardware and software of the locking mechanism can meet the technical requirements, and has good accuracy and efficiency. The research provides a certain reference for the research of electronic control unit of automatic control system of locking mechanism.

articleTitle: Study on THz Spectral Characteristics of Natural Ester Insulation Oil
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Natural ester not only has the advantages of excellent biodegradability and environmental protection, but also has a higher fire rating and anti-overload ability. Therefore, it is an excellent insulation liquid material. In this paper, terahertz time-domain spectroscopy (THz-TDS) is used to study the characteristics of natural ester (FR3) insulation oil in THz range. The results show that: the FR3 insulation oil has an average refractive index of 1.533 in the range of 0.1-1.80THz, and there are two absorption peaks at 1.30THz and 1.50THz. The average values of the real part of complex permittivity and dielectric loss of FR3 in 0.1-1.80Thz are 2.353 and 0.002, and there is relaxation behavior in 1.30Thz and 1.50Thz. This article lays a foundation for studying the THz properties of FR3 insulation oil and has important practical significance.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Evaluation Method for Asphalt Pavement Construction Quality Based on Internet of Things Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The construction quality of asphalt pavement affects the running quality and service life of the pavement. Poor construction quality is the main cause of early water damage, rutting, insufficient skidding and other pavement diseases. In order to effectively and quantitatively evaluate the construction quality of asphalt pavement, this paper deeply analyzes the influencing factors of asphalt pavement construction quality, establishes an asphalt pavement construction quality control system based on Internet of Things technology, and then calibrates the weight factors of each influencing factor based on expert investigation and analytic hierarchy process. Finally, a comprehensive evaluation method of asphalt pavement construction quality based on the Internet of Things technology and a pavement quality index are proposed, and the effectiveness and accuracy of the evaluation method are verified through case analysis. The results show that the method can better reflect the overall advantages and disadvantages of the compaction index of the field detection data, and has good promotion significance.

Author Keywords: comprehensive evaluation method of asphalt pavement construction quality

articleTitle: Design of a marine hydrogen fuel cell management system based on multi-sensor fusion
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: As a new generation of clean energy, hydrogen fuel cells have been used in the marine industry, and their safety monitoring is an important measure to ensure the safe operation of ships. The system uses multiple sensors to determine the current operating status through real-time information fusion, and uses pulse width to regulate the flow rate of the inlet valve to achieve safe control of the hydrogen fuel and maximise its output power. The article analyses the composition of the control system, the sensor system and its working principle, and uses an STM32-based microprocessor to design the safety control hardware and give the implementation flow of its software algorithm. The test results show that the system is capable of monitoring the safety of the marine hydrogen fuel cell under operating conditions and can cut off the inlet valve in case of emergency to achieve the safety control function.

articleTitle: An Improved Grey Neural Network Prediction
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Disturbance factor is too large when the system or the system behavior at some point mutations, severe disturbance abnormal data in the system, this paper puts forward should not be directly according to the original data modeling prediction, but should be properly for data preprocessing, whether the actual situation is proposed based on improved grey neural network combination forecast revisions. Finally, an improved grey neural network model based on data correction is established according to the time series of passenger transport in a station, and good results are obtained.

Author Keywords: A grey neural network combination forecast revisions
an improved grey neural network model

articleTitle: Evaluation and Optimization of Neutral Grounding Methods for High-Proportion Cable Distribution Networks Considering Wind Power Access
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Considering large capacitance current of the high proportion cable distribution network, coupled with the influence of wind turbine access on the selection of the distribution network grounding, single-phase is only generated in the traditional wind-powered high-proportion cable distribution network through ASC grounding Ground fault grounding method is evaluated. Faced with the problems of traditional grounding methods, an optimized grounding scheme was proposed in which the neutral point of the distribution network was connected in parallel with a small resistance via an ASC and wind turbine variable grounding method was used. Theoretical analysis and simulation results show that the improved neutral grounding method is superior to the traditional grounding method in limiting the transient overvoltage of single-phase grounding faults. It can improve the power supply reliability of the distribution network and the equipment safety. The fault line selection is easier without affecting the operation of the wind turbine. It can be applied in the distribution network with a high proportion of the cable line connected by the wind turbine.

articleTitle: Characteristics of New Media Communication, Diligence and User Recognition in Colleges and Universities – Based on the Empirical Study on the WeChat Public Number of the Communist Youth League of 1125 Universities in China
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: This paper takes the Qingbo annual report of the Communist Youth League WeChat public number of colleges and universities in 2018 as the research data, uses the SPSS20.0 tool, uses the factor analysis method, constructs the multivariate regression model, puts forward the theoretical hypothesis and carries on the empirical analysis to the university Communist Youth League WeChat public number dissemination power, the diligence ability and the user recognition influence factor; This paper puts forward some countermeasures and suggestions to increase the number of hot months, improve the quality of content output, speed up the frequency of content originality, increase the cost of operation, increase the quantity of content push, strengthen the ability of content creation, listen to the feedback voice of users, meet the needs of users, and create single fine articles.

articleTitle: Multi-Rate Data Fusion for Wireless Sensor Networks with Time-Delay Based on Improved Cubature Kalman Filter
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of time-delay in wireless sensor networks (WSNs), a multi-rate fusion method is proposed from the perspective of data fusion. The sensor uses different sampling and transmission rates for data collection and transmission. Firstly, in order to enhance the adaptability of cubature Kalman filter (CKF), the filtering performance of CKF is further improved. In this paper, the covariance matrix is modified online by constructing adaptive factors. The improved cubature Kalman filter (ICKF) is used to process these data collected by sensor nodes to generate local estimation (LE), and then the LE is formed into fusion estimation (FE) in the fusion center. The simulation results show that, compared with the traditional CKF and unscented Kalman filter (UKF), the ICKF algorithm has higher estimation performance and better stability.

articleTitle: Wavelet Network Network Diagnosis Method for Soft Fault in Analog Circuit
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In order to raise the diagnosis ability for soft fault of analog circuits, a diagnosis method using Wavelet Neural Network (WNN) is proposed for handling the soft faults. According to the designed fault diagnosis flow of the analog circuit, WNN diagnosis model is constructed for soft fault. Simulation of Sallen-key filter shows that the proposed method has high diagnosis accuracy and is effective and feasible for diagnosing the soft fault in analog circuits.

articleTitle: Analysis of the fit between architectural planning and design and human settlement environment based on Markov model
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Residential buildings are people's main living space. People's economic ability and living standard are constantly improving, and their requirements for living environment are also constantly improving. Residential design and planning based on living environment must face the market, understand the needs of users, plan and design according to the local natural and cultural environment, ensure the integrity of indoor and outdoor functions, and promote sustainable development and meet the needs of residents' living environment by combining the concept of energy conservation and environmental protection. Grey GM (1,1) model has a single method in planning and design due to its own limitations. In this paper, a prediction model, Grey Markov Model, is proposed, which combines the advantages of Grey Model and Markov Model to judge the development trend of buildings together, and verifies the feasibility of internal and external planning and design of residential buildings in human settlements through examples.

articleTitle: Application of Spectral Analysis Model Transfer Technology Based on Radial Basis Function Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Model transfer is an important method to solve the problem that the difference between NIR spectroscopy instruments makes it difficult to use calibration models among multiple instruments. Use a set of standard sample spectra to establish the prediction error minimization function of the near-infrared spectroscopy model of the master instrument and the slave instrument. By adjusting the difference between the model parameters of the master instrument and the slave instrument, the model parameters of the slave machine are obtained, so as to achieve the purpose of model transfer. This paper compares the Piecewise Direct Standardization, the Piecewise Direct Standardization BP neural network, and the Piecewise Direct Standardization radial basis neural network based on the near-infrared model transfer for the determination of nitrogen content in plastics. The results show that the neural network eliminates the strange sharp peaks in the transfer spectrum. However, it did not get a better model transfer effect than PDS, and there is no big nonlinear difference between the master instrument and the slave instrument. Generally, only a linear PDS-PLS model transfer algorithm can achieve a more satisfactory transfer effect.

articleTitle: Map Updating Revisited for Navigation Map : A mathematical way to perform map updating for autonomous mobile robot
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Simultaneous localization and mapping, SLAM can product a Map for autonomous robots and self-driving vehicle in navigation. In the actual environment, the scene changes frequently, which makes the old map no long reliable. Therefore, it is necessary to update such a map by an efficient and safely way. In this paper, we review the existing map updating, long-term localization methods and discuss about the challenges in this situation. We present a Map updating method in mathematical way which can update accurately. Our proposed method are tested in five indoor dataset and demonstrated feasibility.

articleTitle: Research on Interior Thermal Environment Design Based on Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Indoor environment is closely related to people's life, its quality directly affects the quality of people's life, the indoor environment is a comprehensive environment, however, the current research on indoor environmental comfort are mostly just in view of indoor thermal, optical, acoustic environmental comfort or some aspect of the air quality, and not to combine it. The fusion evaluation algorithm of indoor thermal environment comfort based on neural network is adopted, which can realize the comprehensive design of indoor environment better.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Remote Multimedia Physical Education Teaching System Based on Mobile Terminal
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of modern information technology, the development of Internet technology has deeply influenced people's life style and economic activities, and has also changed the traditional education mode. College physical education informatization is a teaching method that combines Internet technology with college physical education. It has the advantages of high efficiency, intelligence and versatility, and can quickly transmit physical education information to students through the network. Smart classroom makes full use of the network education platform, integrates high-quality educational information resources, extends the course teaching from in-class to out-of-class, and changes the traditional passive learning into independent inquiry learning, which fundamentally changes the learning style. Under the background of diversified information technology, our education has been fully developed. This paper analyzes the influence of mobile learning on college physical education and the application of digital resources in college physical education, so as to explore the design and implementation method of remote multimedia physical education system based on mobile terminal.

articleTitle: Asymmetric Analysis of Anti-Terrorist Operations and Demand for Light Weapons under the Condition of Informationization
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Asymmetric warfare and anti-terrorist war have become a new style of military struggle in the new century, which will inevitably have an important impact on the military economy of various countries and catalyze the innovation climax of military logistics theory and practice. The war in the information age is the confrontation between systems, and “comprehensive integration” is not only the idea of information war ability construction, but also the idea of deterrence ability construction in the information age. Looking at the local wars under the conditions of modern informationization, it is not difficult to see that the status and role of light weapons and equipment have not decreased, on the contrary, higher demands have been put forward for their combat performance. From a forward-looking perspective, based on our army's preparation and logistics support for future asymmetric operations and anti-terrorist military struggle, this strategic issue is discussed in depth.

articleTitle: Research on Ignition Time Control of Initiating Explosive Device Based on Magnetoelectric Energy Converter
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In order to meet the requirements of rapid reaction and high firing rate of ammunition in modern battlefield environment, the high instantaneous ignition design of magnetoelectric energy conversion initiating explosive device is carried out. By studying the influence of ammunition overload shock amplitude, charge discharge capacitance and circuit design on the induction ignition time, we can get three ways to reduce the ignition time of initiating explosive device based on magnetoelectric energy conversion: increasing ammunition overload shock amplitude, reducing charge discharge capacitance and using voltage limiter to design control circuit.

articleTitle: Python Based Data Visualization and Configurable Teaching System Design and Implementation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: This paper designs and implements a configurable teaching system for data visualization through Python, builds a visualization and analysis framework for hybrid teaching data combining the general process of data visualization, discusses the implementation process and mechanism of hybrid teaching data visualization from two dimensions of timeliness and media form, introduces numerical, textual, and hybrid numerical and textual data visualization processing methods, and discusses the visualization results are explored for interactive presentation processes. The experimental class that integrates the application of data visualization results achieves better pedagogical results than the reference class that does not apply data visualization results. The experiment validated the effectiveness of the application of data visualization in blended instruction. This study also gives suggestions for optimizing the application strategy of data visualization technology in blended teaching, in the hope that it can provide a reference for the implementation of the data-driven precision teaching process.

articleTitle: Research of Android APP based on dynamic and static analysis Sensitive behavior detection
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: For a long time, there have been a number of malicious APP discovery and detection services in the Android security field. There are multiple and multiple sensitive actions in most malicious apps. This paper is based on the research of dynamic and static detection technology to analyze the sensitive behaviors in APP, combined with automated testing technology to achieve automated detection, which can improve the detection efficiency and accuracy of malicious APP.

articleTitle: Study on Adaptive Filtering Algorithm in the Echo Cancellation in Mine
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: To solve the problem of echo cancellation in mine, the adaptive filtering LMS algorithm is used, firstly, the advantages and disadvantages of the adaptive filtering algorithm are analyzed, then the existing problems of LMS algorithm are improved, and the convergence, anti-noise and stability of the algorithm are analyzed theoretically, in the simulation experiment, the acoustic samples collected in mine are analyzed from aspects of convergence, calculation and output, which shows that the proposed algorithm has a certain effect on the echo cancellation.

articleTitle: Design of Dispersive Module for a 3D Object Shape Detection Device
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Confocal line spectroscopy is proposed for obtaining the three-dimensional shape detection of microscopic objects. An off-axis spectral confocal technology composed of TIR lens, PGP beam splitter and cylindrical lens. The design results show that the PGP dispersive device achieves the linearity of dispersion, and the focal plane formed by this scheme has a working distance of 6.92mm on the z-axis, corresponding to the wavelength range of 450nm-700nm, that is, 27.68 $\mu$ m/nm (1nm wavelength is corresponding to 27.68 microns); At the same time, the focal plane is 20mm long and 6.92mm deep, with the one-dimensional movement of the object, the three-dimensional shape information of the object can be obtained.

articleTitle: Research on Automatic Batch Weighing and Forensic Analysis System of Centralized Filter Membrane
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The dust sampling method is an international standard method for dust detection. Weighing the filter membrane will affect the accuracy of the method. According to research, at present both domestic and foreign countries use manual weighing to weigh the filter membrane after sampling the dust, but manual weighing in this operation will bring new errors; at the same time, when batch weighing, manual weighing is slow, Poor practicality. In order to eliminate the interference of external factors and increase the speed of filter membrane weighing, this paper designed a centralized automatic batch membrane filter weighing and forensic analysis system. This article discusses in detail from the key units of the system: environmental control unit, automatic weighing unit and system control unit. Experiments show that the system can quickly and accurately weigh the sampling filter membrane in batches, and record the weight of the filter membrane and other information.

articleTitle: Research on Seamless Switching Method between Grid and Island
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The seamless switching control strategy between grid-connected microgrid and island operation mode is an important factor to ensure its safe and stable operation. The new master-slave control strategy and the peer-to-peer control strategy are combined to control the switching process of the grid-connected mode of the micro-grid to the island mode. A microgrid simulation model combining photovoltaic cells and batteries was built on the DigSILENT/PowerFactory platform to verify the correctness of the proposed control strategy and ensure the stability of the active, reactive, voltage and frequency of the microgrid.

articleTitle: A sleep staging algorithm for SAHA detection based on C4/A1 EEG
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: SAHS event accurate detection is vital for sleep monitoring and auxiliary ventilation therapy. Studies have shown that 63.71% SAHS false-positive error occurred during sleep awakening period. This paper puts forward a kind of sleep state recognition algorithm based on single channel C4/A1 EEG to Complete the screening of monitoring data of oronasal flow and abdominal displacement, which can raise the accuracy of SAHS detection and classification. Considering the comfort of long-term sleep monitoring, this paper choose EEG signal, oronasal flow signal and abdominal displacement signal as the research object. The fifth-order Daubechies wavelet is used to extract C4/A1 single channel EEG rhythm signal. Then the 12-dimensional feature vector is constructed from the EEG rhythm energy ratio, sample entropy mean value and variance. After dimensionality reduction in Principal Component Analysis (PCA) analysis, sleep/wake classification is performed using SVM, so as to complete data screening of oronasal flow and abdominal displacement data. 3000 sample dataset of 30 second C4/A1 EEG data were randomly selected from 15 subjects. The proportion of sleep and wake is 1:1, and the proportion of training set and test set is 2:1. The results of sleep/wake classification shows that the average accuracy of training set is 89.0%, and the average precision of training set is 89.6%, and the average accuracy of test set is 88.6%, and the average precision of test set is 89.2%. The Support Vector Machine (SVM) model is used to effectively realize the sleep/wake classification for SAHS detection. The overall classification accuracy is 83.94%, the average sensitivity rate is 86.07%, and the false positive rate decreases from 28.19% to 5.34%, indicating a significant improvement. The proposed sleep staging algorithm can improve SAHS detection effectivity and which may provide technical support for subsequent realtime monitoring of SAHS and personalized assisted ventilation therapy.

articleTitle: Study on Coupling Coordination Degree of Integration and Development of Tourism and Cultural Industry in China Based on Computer Software Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: As sunrise industries, cultural industry and tourism industry have gradually deepened their integration with the dual promotion of policy support and market demand, forming a new cultural tourism industry. At present, culture has become a value dimension of economic and social development in the world, and as a “sunrise industry”, the cultural industry has risen rapidly in the world. Based on the analysis of computer software, this paper makes an empirical study on the coupling coordination degree of supply and demand system of tourist hotels in China. The results show that the order degree of supply system of tourist hotels in China is higher than that of demand system, and supply exceeds demand; The western region needs to further increase investment in tourism capital, technology, talents, policies and other factors, so as to transform the advantages of ecological environment into the advantages of tourism development.

articleTitle: A Novel Multi-Sensor Crash Safety System Targeting Heavy Duty Vehicle Blind Spots
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Roughly 500,000 traffic accidents involving Heavy Duty Vehicles (HDVs) occur yearly in the United States. The primary cause for these accidents stems from the presence of substantial blind spots, regions around the HDV not visible to the driver. Existing solutions to blind spots are the use of camera monitors, sensors, or additional mirrors, but these options have limited success when working in varying weather conditions or different road types. This article proposes a blind spot safety protection system targeting heavy duty vehicle blind spots based on multi-sensor information fusion. The system evaluates the location of pedestrians and other vehicles near the heavy duty vehicle through ultrasonic, touch, and vision sensors. The driver is alerted of potential dangers, such as a nearby pedestrian, through the monitor and a wristband. In the scenario of a crash, pedestrians, external vehicles, and the heavy duty vehicle itself are protected by external airbags. This paper investigates optimal camera threshold settings under different light conditions, and evaluates the field of vision of the camera monitor subsystem. The experimental results indicate that the designed system can protect a blind spot area of approximately 80.3m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. The use of multiple sensors can effectively improve the robustness of safety detection. The designed system has extraordinary significance for protecting pedestrian, vehicle, and HDV safety.

articleTitle: Research and Simulation of UAV Three-Dimensional Path Replanning in Complex Environment
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In order to make the research of unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) path replanning closer to the actual combat environment, a path replanning algorithm for UAV based on model-based predictive control and particle swarm optimization is proposed to study the three-dimensional (3D) path replanning problem in situations involving multiple kinds of threats. Firstly, the interactive model of constant velocity (CV) model and coordinated turn (CT) model is used to describe the motion state of the sudden threat, and the Kalman filter method is used to predict the state of the sudden threat, considering the systematic error in the movement process of the sudden threat and the detection error of the airborne radar. Then, based on the 3D dynamics model of UAV, a 3D path planning model is established, and the path replanning problem is transformed into a series of optimization sub-problems by using the idea of model-based predictive control (MPC). Finally, the sub-problem is solved by using particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm. The experimental results show that the trajectory prediction of motion sudden threat in this paper is more accurate, and the designed algorithm not only meets the validity and real-time requirements of path replanning, but also has strong robustness.

articleTitle: Design of a New Intelligent City Bus System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Nowadays, the city bus system develops rapidly, but there are still many problems in the current bus system that affects people's travel convenience and safety of life and property. To solve the problems in the bus system, in this paper, a new urban bus system is proposed by combining intelligent sensor equipment and wireless communication technology. This bus system can realize passenger detection, bus door to prevent accidental clamping, driver's health monitoring, bus dynamic space allocation, real-time feedback of bus information and other functions. Besides, passengers can get access to the bus real-time information to reasonably plan their travel mode and travel route. Therefore, people's travel accessibility, punctuality and safety are increased. Considering the travel of the disabled, this paper also proposes automated barrier-free ramp, voice prompts and other functions so that the disabled can also benefit the convenience brought by urban development.

articleTitle: Transformation of Cigarette Products Warehousing Electric Control System of Automatic Logistics Based on Recycling Smoke Box with Oddment and Stock
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In order to further increase the usage amount of recycling smoke box, this paper solve the warehousing of the cigarette products using the recycling smoke box with oddment and stock, the distinction between storage and classification management problems, based on with the Project 1 bar code online printed in the early paper, the electric control system of automatic logistics was transformed as following: 1) Increasing the warehouse bar code to provide storage recognition of identity; 2) Adding the corresponding bar code scanner into the bus control to set up vigorous hardware; 3) Reconstructing the working logic of the two bar code scanners and modifying the judging conditions to determine the storage in the PLC control program to perfect the software. The results of application showed that the system meets the design objective after improvement, the cigarette finished products using the recycling smoke box are 100% put in storage in a more efficient way, in contrast with former no warehousing, and can be divided according to brand, specification, old and new smoke box, and machine type. We have realized automatic sorting of cigarette products, and classification storage and management, what's more, the two functions are extended to four functions flexible switching between each other implemented on the same device.

articleTitle: A Convolutional Neural Network Algorithm Based on Rough Set Rule Extraction
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of rough set rule extraction optimization of rough set model, an optimization method combining convolutional neural network with gradient algorithm is proposed. Convolutional neural network has the advantage of global optimization, but there are easy prematurity and local defects of optimal performance is poor, so this article combined with the gradient algorithm, in order to complete the video image detection of the human body, to take the rough set rules extraction network model, network model still exist at the same time because of rough set rules to extract objects with different size, proportion disparity detection problem of the object, in this paper, the network structure and algorithm to optimize certain adjustment function. In order to retain the time information of the video, the dependence of the feedback time dimension of the convolutional neural network is introduced. However, the gradient disappearance will occur in the common RNN, so this paper intends to use the long and short memory convolutional neural network (LSTM) for training. By reserving the optimal solution of the iterative process, the search speed of the gradient algorithm is accelerated and the convergence of the method to the global optimal solution is ensured, and the global convergence and the computational speed are achieved.

Author Keywords: Rough set rule extraction network model
Rough set rules extraction and optimization

articleTitle: Research on Weld Recognition Method Based on Mask R-CNN
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In order to improve the efficiency of welding operations and the quality of welding products, reduce the work intensity of welders and improve the harsh working environment, through the welding seam tracking technology, the welding seam image collected by the camera is transferred to the computer for welding seam recognition and automatic welding seam image Recognition is the key technology for research on automated weld tracking. In this paper, the Mask R-CNN model is applied to the recognition of micro-gap welds. This method uses deep learning network for feature extraction, and realizes weld recognition and location. First, the Mask RCNN convolutional neural network is used to extract weld features from the weld image, and then the least square method and weld centerline extraction are used to obtain the width, angle and position of the weld to facilitate real-time tracking and positioning of the welding. The recognition accuracy rate is over 97%. The results show that, compared with traditional machine vision methods, the deep learning Mask R-CNN model has the ability to automatically learn from the training set, abandons the learning features manually set, and greatly improves the recognition efficiency and adaptability.

articleTitle: Research on Link Prediction under the Structural Features of Attention Stream Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The attention flow network is an important branch of network science, and the research on the link prediction algorithm of attention flow network has important theoretical and application value. The traditional link prediction algorithm based on the neighbor hypothesis cannot learn the global structure information of the network, while the traditional graph neural network algorithm needs to combine external information and has a large amount of calculation. Based on the structural characteristics and the advantages of the MLP neural network, this paper proposes a stru2vec-based algorithm. The link prediction SMLP algorithm is compared with the existing DeepWalk, Line, Node2vec, Hope, NetMF and other algorithms. It is found that the SMLP algorithm proposed in this paper improves on the four evaluation indicators of Precision, Recall, Accuracy and F1 by about 15.8% on average. The average increase in AUC index is about 12.1%, and the performance is better on the ROC curve, and the algorithm proposed in this paper focuses on learning the network structure, and has a good learning effect for the network with missing node label information and sparse self-characteristic attributes.

articleTitle: Fundus Image Segmentation Using Step Time Signal Polynomial Fitting
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Image segmentation is a basic and important strategy to extract the region of interesting (ROI). However the ROI of retinal fundus image, such as the foreground or optic disc, often could not be generated correctly, due to poor lighting environments, physiological features or improper imaging equipment. Hence, a novel fundus image segmentation method is proposed in this paper. Briefly speaking, considering each line of fundus image as a time series signal, we adopt a step time series signal polynomial curve fitting methodology to smooth the noise and to exclude all features in the fundus image without any loss of the target margin. After fitting the fundus image, a refinement tactic with Kmeans algorithm is used to obtain the final segmentation results. This unsupervised segmentation approach is a completely robust method, because all break points in the signal are detected automatically by the Buishand Range (BR) homogeneity breakpoint detection algorithm. To demonstrate the experimental performance of our new proposal, the test results of foreground segmentation have been compared with their ground truth on DRIVE and STARE datasets, and yield an encouraging performance. Based on these two public datasets and our private database which have been annotated by the medical experts, the experimental outputs of optic disk segmentation achieve the average overlap area ratio of 92.88%, outperforming existing unsupervised methods in this field.

Author Keywords: Step time series signal polynomial fitting

articleTitle: Hypergraph Regularized SVM and Its Application Emotion Detection
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: We propose a method attribute called Learning Frame Emotion Detection based on Hypergraph-based Support Vector Machine (SVM). A hypergraph is used in this HISVM to display various emotional relationships in the results. Then the topic of emotional forecasting is cast out as a regularized problem of Hypergraph cutting, where HISVM learns together a sequence of emotional forecasts from the functional space to a Hypergraph Embedded Vector Space that is harmonized with the different emotions. The predictions learned was directly categorized by emotion. This is a compelling strategy-this formulation. Our proposed algorithm will implement other available details, including class labels, flexibly by treating our model as a multifaceted cutting job. Hypergraph Optimized Vector Assistance Machine, we extend our approach to emotion identification. As a significant preprocessing level, selection features are thought to define the most distinctive functions for a compact statistical analysis in many machine learning and model recognition fields. Then we propose a regularized word, a regularized Hypergraph SVM algorithm. We perform tests on various data sets from SVM's machine learning algorithm and two text-based expression grading projects in the real world. Experimental findings show the proposed process's positive results compared to many standard selection methods for emotional characteristics.

articleTitle: Wireless Charging System for Electric Vehicles with Auxiliary Coils
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Magnetic resonance coupling radio energy transmission technology has become a research hotspot of radio energy transmission technology because of its advantages of high transmission efficiency, long transmission distance and small transmission radiation distance and small transmission radiation. However, when two coils transmit energy through magnetic coupling, they have the disadvantages of low transmission efficiency in low coupling region and “frequency splitting” phenomenon in medium and high coupling region. In this paper, the solution of loading the auxiliary coil is presented, and the radio energy transmission system before and after loading the auxiliary coil is modeled and analyzed. Then, the paper deduces the theoretical relation and simulates the transmission efficiency and output power before and after loading the auxiliary coil, and carries out the experimental verification. Theoretical analysis, simulation and experimental structure all verify the effectiveness of the loading auxiliary coil.

articleTitle: Quantitative evaluation model of desensitization algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Today, with the explosive growth of data volume, data has become an increasingly important strategic resource for various enterprises, but Big Data not only facilitates human society, but also brings huge privacy leakage problem. Because the data in business production often contains a large amount of user sensitive privacy information, in order to avoid the privacy leakage of these data in the test system and other environments, enterprises begin to pay more attention to desensitization technology. Because desensitization is mainly used in the process of software development in the business field, and is often used to generate internal test data, most of the results are classified or protected by patents. In addition, the evaluation of desensitization algorithm mostly stays at the level of general and qualitative evaluation. At present, there is no intuitive, accurate and universal quantitative evaluation standard. In this paper, aiming at the pain point of desensitization evaluation model, a data oriented quantitative desensitization evaluation model based on association rule mining method is designed. The model does not need to understand the desensitization algorithm design process, but only faces the data set before and after desensitization, which reduces the risk of desensitization algorithm leakage. In addition, the model also covers the common fields of various industries, and accurately and intuitively describes the availability of desensitization data in the subsequent test environment in the form of quantitative numbers, which provides an innovative idea for the unification of desensitization algorithm evaluation standards.

articleTitle: Medical Text Entity Recognition Based on CRF and Joint Entity
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Named entity recognition in Chinese electronic medical record is the core technology of key information mining in electronic medical record. The purpose of entity recognition is to identify the different categories of valuable entities in electronic medical records. However, there are some serious problems in Chinese electronic medical records, such as complicated disease names, clinical symptoms and drug names, different doctors’ use of professional terms, irregular writing, excessive professional terms, and unclear boundaries between different entities. At the same time, because it involves the privacy of patients, and unauthorized disclosure of such medical text information is not in line with national regulations. Therefore, at present, there is almost no public Chinese electronic medical record corpus, and all these problems increase the difficulty of entity identification in Chinese electronic medical record. In order to better identify entities in medical texts, this paper formulates a set of labeling rules for medical texts, and gives full play to the advantages of machine learning on top of the data set of this set of autonomous labeling rules. Conditional Random Field model CRF (Conditional Random Field) is used to obtain good experimental results. In the entity recognition experiment of a large number of medical records, the accuracy rate, recall rate and F value are improved to 87.92%, 82.33 and 85.03%, which are better than the evaluation indexes of existing studies and can meet the needs of practical application.

articleTitle: Global and Node Attributes of Binary Brain Function Network Related to Emotion
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: This paper studies the functional connection of brain regions by using network analysis method. Through the analysis of network attributes, the influence of different emotions on brain functional network connection and the construction method of brain functional network are learned. In this paper, we used Electroencephalogram (EEG) signals to construct the binary brain networks based on correlation and phase synchrony. Firstly, the global network attributes under different emotions were studied, and the results obtained by different network construction methods were compared. We find that the brain functional networks with different definitions share common characteristics in the global attribute change. Secondly, the node attributes were analyzed. The results show that the node attributes of brain functional network, such as degree, betweenness centrality and local efficiency, can reflect the change of emotion. This paper provides clues for the study of emotional brain network analysis.

articleTitle: Research on equipment fault detection based on boundary-based OCC-KELM
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In response to the short installation time of active equipment, the lack of various fault samples, the difficulty of obtaining, and the low accuracy of existing algorithms for fault detection, the kernel ELM is used as the basic modeling framework, and the boundary-based threshold selection criteria are used; Combine extreme learning with one-class detection, and propose BB-OCKELM detection model. Based on the kernel ELM, and at the same time integrating the idea of one-class detection, the constraint optimization problem of KELM is realized under the constraint of lp-norm, and the output function expression of a unified one-class KELM classifier is derived; for the convenience of fault detection Implementation, based on BB-OCKELM to define the statistical inspection volume and detection threshold. The proposed method is applied to four common data sets commonly used in the field of machine learning and the fault detection application of a certain type of equipment. The experimental results show that the proposed method is suitable for comparison with SVDD, PCA, OC-SVM, and OC-KELM. For different public data sets, the proposed method can effectively balance missed and false alarms, and significantly improve the accuracy of fault detection when the time cost is equivalent.

articleTitle: Design and Optimization of Two-Loop Pilot for Tactical Missile
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The specific scheme of two-loop attitude control system was formulated based on the design principle of attitude control system with the damping circuit as the inner loop and the overload control loop as the outer one. As required by the formulated scheme, the damping loop is designed firstly, of which the stability and the dynamic response quality are improved by adjusting the damping coefficient and the addition of the correction network. After that, the design and optimization of the overload control loop are implemented. With the same design method, gain coefficient and correction network are introduced to reduce overshoot of overload response curve, shorten response time and improve efficiency. Besides, the validity of the overload control loop is tested with square wave as input to reflect the real overload command signal.

articleTitle: Research on Parallel K-Nearest Neighbor Query Optimization Method for Highway Big Data
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Because the information in the field of engineering construction involves remote sensing recognition, intelligent transportation, etc. The rapid growth of various types of information makes highway data continue to develop toward the trend of big data in terms of scale, type, and structure, showing the characteristics of multi-source heterogeneous. This article discusses efficient data retrieval and query methods for specific highway basic databases and simulated highway spatial large data sets. In order to better manage spatial objects and maintain their positional relationship with grid cells, it is proposed to combine inverted index with grid index. In order to break the dependence of the rim radius on the previous traversal results, the serial rim access K nearest neighbor (KNN) algorithm is appropriately improved, and the rim radius is updated by increasing the mesh side length, combined with multi-threading technology Achieve access to multiple rims to improve the query performance of highway big data. Test data by modifying the size, spatial grid sides and these K values, the average performance are improved.

articleTitle: Application of Neural Network in Restoring Metro ESP Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The distribution of DC surface potential (DCESP) is the key to the DC bias of power system transformers, and the stray current of rail transit traction power supply will affect the distribution of (DCESP). The distribution of DC surface potential (DCESP) is the key to the DC bias of power system transformers, and the stray current of rail transit traction power supply will affect the distribution of (DCESP). The distribution of DC surface potential is affected by the magnitude and location of the DC current into the ground, as well as soil structure and parameters. The topography between the two existing substations is complex, especially in cities, which are affected by factors such as highways and buildings. The number of locations for measuring ground potential data is limited and discontinuous. Based on electromagnetic theory, this paper derives the DCESP distribution calculation formula for the multilayer vertical geoelectric structure, and builds an accurate subway system model in CDEGS, and simulates the DCESP distribution data around the subway. Design a neural network to restore DCESP, thereby reducing the workload of ESP measurement and calculation. The research results of this paper provide a new idea for DC surface potential measurement, which can promote the development of DC bias field.

articleTitle: Performance Impact of Host Kernel Page Table Isolation on Virtualized Servers
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: As Meltdown mitigation, Kernel Page Table I solation (KPTI) was merged into Linux kernel mainline, and the performance impact is significant on x86 processors. Most of the previous work focuses on how KPTI affects Linux kernel performance within the scope of virtual machines or physical machines on x86. However, whether host KPTI affects virtual machines has not been well studied. What's more, there is relatively little research on ARM CPUs. This paper presents an in-depth study of how KPTI on the host affects the virtualized server performance and compares ARMv8 and x86. We first run several application benchmarks to demonstrate the performance impact does exist. The reason is that with a para-virtual I/O scheme, guest offloads I/O requests to the host side, which may incur user/kernel transitions. For the network I/O, when using QEMU as the back-end device, we saw a 1.7% and 5.5% slowdown on ARMv8 and x86, respectively. vhost and vhost-user, originally proposed to optimize performance, inadvertently mitigate the performance impact introduced by host KPTI. For CPU and memory-intensive benchmarks, the performance impact is trivial. We also find that virtual machines on ARMv8 are less affected by KPTI. To diagnose the root cause, we port HyperBench to the ARM virtualization platform. The final results show that swapping the translation table pointer register on ARMv8 is about 3.5x faster than x86. Our findings have significant implications for tuning the x86 virtualization platform's performance and helping ARMv8 administrators enable KPTI with confidence.

articleTitle: Transformation of Cigarette Products Warehousing Electric Control System of Automatic Logistics Based on Recycling Smoke Box with Online Bar Code
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In order to solve the warehousing of the cigarette products using the recycling smoke box with online bar code, the distinction between storage and classification management problems, the warehousing electric control system of automatic logistics was transformed as following: 1) Increasing the box warehousing bar code to provide storage recognition of identity; 2) Adding the corresponding bar code scanner into the bus control system to set up robust hardware;}3)Reconstructing the working “and” logic of the two bar code scanners and modifying the judging conditions to determine the warehousing in the PLC control program to perfect the software. The results of application showed that the system meets the design objective after improvement. The cigarette products using the recycling smoke box are 100% put in storage in a more efficient way, in contrast with former no warehousing, and can be divided according to brand, specification, old and new smoke box, and machine type. We have realized automatic sorting of cigarette products, and classification storage and management.

articleTitle: F-SGX: Next Generation SGX for Trusted Computing
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The existing methods of constructing a trusted computing environment do not fully meet the requirements. Intel SGX provides a new hardware foundation for the construction of trusted computing environment. However, existing SGX still faces problems such as side channel attacks. To overcome it, this paper present F-SGX which is the future SGX for trusting computing. In our opinion, F-SGX hold stronger isolation than current SGX, and reduce the dependence of enclave on host operating system. Furthermore, F-SGX hold a private key for the attestation. We believe that F-SGX can further provide better support for trusting computing environments while there is a good balance between isolation and dependencies.

articleTitle: Overview of Research on Virtual Intelligent Human Modeling Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Virtual intelligent human modeling is a key issue in the field of virtual reality research, and it is of great significance in academic research and practical applications. This article focuses on the virtual intelligent human modeling technology, introduces the concepts of virtual intelligent human, virtual intelligent human modeling, etc., combs the current research status at home and abroad, and summarizes virtual intelligent human geometric modeling, motion modeling, emotional modeling technology and comparative analysis of each technology. At the end of the article, based on the development background of the times, the future development trend of virtual intelligent human modeling is prospected.

articleTitle: Novel technology for acquiring wheel motion attitude information based on WEIS
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: As the wheel speed sensing methods of anti-lock braking system (ABS) in traditional wheel motion attitude MAP monitoring are mostly limited to measuring the two parameters of wheel angular velocity and angular acceleration, and there are reports that the tire condition test technology by installing three acceleration sensors at specific test points inside the tire to obtain tire condition information cannot further obtain wheel attitude angle, speed, rotation parameter information, etc., this paper proposes a novel technology for acquiring wheel motion attitude information based on WEIS, which calculates and obtains all the MAP information of the wheel by placing an intelligent three-dimensional acceleration sensor unit on the wheel hub and using the wheel MAP monitoring model. The experimental results indicate that the average error of wheel camber angle γi under experimental conditions is 0.0734°, the average error of wheel tangential velocity νsTi is 0.1480m/s, the average error of wheel angular velocity ωi is 0. 5420rad/s and its relative error is 2.25%. This new technology can measure 11 of the 27 condition monitoring parameters for the safe operation of motor vehicles, and the performance indicators have reached better measurement accuracy and achieved the expected effects.

articleTitle: Hierarchical urban land use and its 3D application
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Urban land use information is of great significance for many applications based on Geographic Information System (GIS), such as autonomous driving. There are big differences in people, objects, and their movement patterns in different land-use types, which is a big challenge for autonomous driving. And the existing virtual autonomous driving simulation rarely considers the transition between different land types. Traditional land-use planning methods are mostly based on simulation modeling of agents. It simulates the early urban development process in reality and spreads from the center of the topographic map to the outside, which usually takes a long time. To improve the efficiency of land use simulation, this paper proposes a spatial adaptive parallel simulation algorithm: Based on the value of land development, the land area is adaptively divided based on the quad-tree structure, and perform agent-based urban development simulation operations on the divided sub-areas. After the simulation is completed, the land-use type of the divided sub-areas is determined according to the “voting” rule. Finally, the corresponding 3D city model is constructed according to the land-use type, and the 3D buildings of each area and their distribution are automatically generated according to the land-use type using a procedural method. The experimental results prove the effectiveness of the method in this paper, and the 3D virtual city constructed according to this method can be used in urban construction, games, movie production, and autonomous driving simulation.

articleTitle: Interrelated information pair extraction algorithm of visual attention for form documents
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Information extraction technology of form documents plays an important role in facilitating the retention and retrieval of forms. The existing algorithms for form information extraction usually lacks certain accuracy and universality. In this paper, an algorithm of structured key information extraction for forms is proposed, which takes into account image features and text layout of forms, and is universal to different kinds of forms. First, a keywords and key information detection network is designed to detect information blocks. Then considering the characteristics of text layout based on human visual attention mechanism, an algorithm of matching keywords and corresponding information based on position relationships is proposed. Finally, the classification of information is realized by fuzzy matching of keywords, so as to extract the structured information quickly and accurately. Experiments show that compared with existing form information extraction systems, this algorithm realizes the extraction of structured information from form documents based on image features and text layout, greatly improving accuracy and universality.

articleTitle: Flight Operation Technology in Future Civil Aircraft
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: This paper reviews the main achievements of the civil aviation flight technology, summarizes the main contradictions and development bottlenecks of civil aviation flight operation. In view of these issues, this paper discusses the civil aviation transportation system, civil aircraft, and airborne system, to research and inferring the possible direction of the future development of civil aviation flight technology. Finally, considering the current major contradictions, the level of aviation industry and the current situation of civil aviation development, the transition period of development that need be undergoing and the required basic technology in future flight technology process are proposed. The future technology route or technology concept discussed in the paper can be used as a reference for the medium and long-term Pre-research of civil aviation, and the basic technology that must be sorted out for the future development can be used as the key point of current research.

articleTitle: Analysis of three-dimensional temperature field and relevant sensitivity factors in magnetic honing system
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Magnetic honing system works in frequency conversion control mode, which produces high harmonic content, resulting in high temperature rise and serious heating. In order to study the temperature distribution law of honing system, the influence of initial temperature of cooling medium and system loss on the temperature rise distribution law of the system. Based on the basic theory of fluid mechanics and the relevant assumptions of the system, the three-dimensional mathematical model and simplified three-dimensional finite element calculation model of the honing system are established. The temperature distribution of the honing system is obtained by using the method of fluid-solid coupling. The effectiveness of the simplified model is verified by the temperature rise test of the honing system. In addition, on the basis of the system temperature field calculation model, the influence of the temperature of the cooling medium and the input of the system on the overall temperature of the system and the temperature distribution law are also considered. This research is of great significance to the thermal loss control and input optimization of magnetic honing system as well as the model optimization and temperature field calculation of small motors.

articleTitle: Head-Driven English Syntactic Translation Model Based on Natural Language Processing
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Natural language is an important symbol of human intelligence, so making computers understand natural language is one of the fundamental tasks of artificial intelligence research. The study of English syntactic analysis has important theoretical value and urgent practical needs. In this paper, a head-driven English syntactic translation model based on natural language processing is designed, which integrates automatically acquired semantic classes into the syntactic analysis model to solve the problem of data sparseness in the model with small samples. Using a semantic dictionary and applying the principle of minimum description length, a semantic class with granularity between parts of speech and vocabulary is automatically determined for the syntactic analysis model. In English chunk analysis task, the algorithm improves the accuracy of chunk analysis, and it can also be applied to other natural language processing tasks or other classification problems.

articleTitle: Assessing Coordination of Pedestrian Facilities in Metro Station Based on Queuing Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The coordination of pedestrian facilities is the basis of design and operation for a Metro station, as it directly determines the final capacity of the whole station. All types of pedestrian facilities used in a Metro station, which can be categorized into three types (servicing facilities, passing facilities, and distributing facilities), are considered in this paper. Models based on queuing theory are established according to facility type. Fixed-and dynamic-service time models are proposed to simulate the servicing facilities; two-stage G/G(n)/C/C models are built for passing facilities; G/G(n)/C/C and G/G/C/C models are designed for distributing facilities. Next, a simulation model based on queuing network theory is designed to estimate the coordination among different pedestrian facilities in the metro station. The Simulink platform was used to run the simulation. Lastly, the data of Hujialou station in Beijing was collected to validate the models. The results demonstrate that the newly developed model is efficiently able to estimate bottlenecks and the coordination of facilities, which has great significance in pre-and post-evaluation for metro station facilities design and performance.

articleTitle: ON-AFN: Generating Image Caption based on the Fusion of Residual Attention and Ordered Memory Module
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a novel and effective Fused Network, which is based on the residual attention mechanism and ordered memory module, a framework for image captioning that enables computer to produce the more accurate natural language description. Inspired by the recent advanced studies, our approach creatively divided our caption survey into two subtasks, one is how to efficiently extract visual features in the image, and the other is how to accurately express the semantic information in the features, and then propose excellent solutions for these tasks. In other words, Ordered Memory Attention Fusion Network is a comprehensive captioning model with the support of residual attention network and ordered memory module. Specially in this model, we innovatively employ the residual attention learning mechanism to optimize the extraction of features, and generate a more accurate and comprehensive natural language caption by applying the ordered memory module. We validated our model through extensive experiments on COCO Captioning benchmark, experiments show that it is conducive to generate the caption with higher accuracy and sets the new state-of-the-art by a significant margin.

articleTitle: Research on Mining Method Based on Multi-task Iterative Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In real life, people's ability to obtain information is increasing, and they often need to deal with data from different source domains. There are differences in the representation, distribution, scale and density of these data. How to learn these multi-source data has become a hot research topic at present. This research point proposes a traffic structure mining method based on multi-task iterative learning. Taking the four key factors affecting traffic travel as characteristic attributes, this paper analyzes the law of their effects on travel behavior. In the learning process, the learner selects unlabeled samples with high confidence to mark each other, which can be used to update the model. After analyzing the shape of the weight matrix of road sections representing extra cost in the superposition model, we find that the model in this paper can effectively restore the peak traffic hours, which is in line with the actual scene.

articleTitle: The Application Analysis of Artificial Intelligence in Computer Network Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In the information age, computer network technology has covered different areas of social life and involved various fields, and artificial intelligence, as an emerging technology with a very rapid development momentum in recent years, is important in promoting the development of computer network systems. This article explains the concept of artificial intelligence technology, describes the problems faced by computer networks, further analyses the advantages of artificial intelligence and the inevitability of application in network technology, and then studies the application of artificial intelligence in computer network technology.

articleTitle: Optimized Design of Grid-connected Microgrid with Renewable Energy
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: First, the mathematical models of wind turbines, photovoltaic arrays and storage batteries in the microgrid are established in the paper. The maximum power point tracking technology of the photovoltaic array based on disturbance method is analyzed. According to the load status control plan and the peak-valley time-of-use electricity price, a dispatch plan that can minimize the cost is initially determined. Secondly, an objective function is established with the microgrid revenue as the target. The power constraints of photovoltaic arrays, wind turbines and batteries are integrated to obtain the best dispatching plan. Finally, a simulation system is built in MATLAB-Simulink for the solar photovoltaic array and wind power generation system in the microgrid, and the stability of the microgrid system is verified based on the simulation data.

articleTitle: Multi-Physical Field Theory Analysis of Electromagnetic Brake Rotor Disc in Automobile Integrated Braking System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The accurate prediction of the temperature rise of the electromagnetic brake is directly related to the reliability of the integrated brake system. In order to obtain the temperature distribution that can not be detected by the test, the eddy current field and temperature field of the electromagnetic rotor of the integrated brake system are studied based on the multi physical field analysis method. The multi-physical field model of the electromagnetic rotor disk of the integrated brake system is established.

Author Keywords: electromagnetic and friction integrated brake system

articleTitle: Design of Touch Control Display Interface Based on Synoptic Page in Civil Aircraft Cockpit
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: This paper analyzes the requirements of improving the efficiency of human-machine interaction in civil aircraft cockpit, identifies the disadvantages of human-machine interaction efficiency and cognition in aircraft cockpit that has used touch screen, and analyzes the interactive characteristics of touch screen in operation. Based on the concept of safety, efficient and comfortable control, this paper expounds the development demand and trend of touch control of civil aircraft cockpit in future. Finally, for the purpose of ensuring control safety and improving control efficiency, an integrated design of touch control and information display based on the synoptic page is proposed, so as to realize the requirements of efficient cognition and convenient control, improve the touch usability, reduce the workload and human errors for pilot.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of E-commerce Recommendation System Model Based on Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the continuous expansion of the company's scale, the original offline sales model can no longer meet the demand. In order to keep up with the current trend of Internet technology, companies need to develop their own e-commerce platform. With the rapid development of e-commerce, its information structure is becoming more and more complex, and the amount of information is becoming larger and larger. Users are often lost in massive commodity information, and merchants cannot establish effective customer relationships in massive user information. In order to improve the service level and market competitiveness of Internet commerce, many e-commerce websites begin to introduce data mining technology. According to users' purchase records and historical browsing records, they can find the goods they like and recommend them to users. In order to manage massive commodity information and user information more efficiently, this paper proposes a solution to build e-commerce recommendation system on the cloud computing platform to improve the ability of massive data mining and business intelligence analysis, and realize high-performance computing at a lower cost.

articleTitle: Pipeline Robot Based on Umbrella-shaped Flexible Expansion
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the development of science and technology in modern society, people have conducted more in-depth research on automatic and semi-automatic robots. This kind of robot is an integrated system of machine, electricity and instrument, which can move in specific areas or areas that people are difficult to enter or operate in person, carry one or more sensors and operating machines, and carry out a series of operations under the remote control operation of workers or automatic control of computers. As an important means of transportation, pipelines are widely used in people's lives. However, if it is not overhauled or cleaned in time, it may lead to pipeline blockage and failure. Considering that the pipeline is a difficult area for workers to enter, and taking inspiration from the stable triangular structure and the contraction and relaxation of the umbrella-shaped structure, a pipeline robot is designed, which can adapt to the pipeline structure with different radius sizes and carry out a series of maintenance and cleaning work. This project mainly includes mechanical structure design, Bluetooth wireless control and installation of cleaning and testing equipment in the manufacturing process. The stable shape of the triangular structure is used to enable the robot to move steadily in the pipeline. Through each motor installed at the three vertices of the triangular structure to drive the roller, and combined with the first umbrella-shaped structure, the robot can travel in the pipeline and adapt in pipelines of different sizes. Arduino controls the rotation direction and speed of the motor to realize different modes of travel. Wireless control is connected to the robot master control through Bluetooth devices such as mobile phones, and sends operation instructions to the pipeline robot when using it to control its actions. A variety of equipment can be installed in the robot body, such as cleaning equipment, detection equipment, camera equipment, etc. The ultimate goal of this project is to realize that robots can move freely in pipelines of different sizes and perform different tasks according to different equipment installed.

articleTitle: Modeling of Vehicle Driving Behavior in Tunnel Entrance Zone Based on Artificial Potential Field Theory
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The special traffic rules and environmental factors in the entrance area of the tunnel increase the difficulty of modeling vehicle driving behavior. In response to this problem, this paper incorporates the speed limit, lane changing restrictions, and other traffic rules and tunnel environment on vehicle driving into the potential field model based on the traditional potential field theory. According to the characteristics of the tunnel entrance area, the vehicle potential field and the lane line potential field were improved respectively, and a new tunnel potential field was established. Besides, the relative velocity is introduced to establish an improved potential field force model. On this basis, the vehicle driving behavior model in the tunnel entrance zone is obtained by analyzing the improved artificial potential field(APF) model established. Besides, the driving simulator is used to collect the driving data of five drivers in the tunnel entrance zone, and the least square method and genetic algorithm are used to calibrate and verify the parameters of the improved artificial potential field. And the driving behavior model was verified through experiments.
