The results of driver-in-the-loop experiments show that the established vehicle driving behavior model can reveal the dynamic evolution of the driving behavior of vehicles in the tunnel entrance zone. It can provide a basis for the study of cooperative driving behavior of vehicles in the tunnel entrance zone and the driving decision-making research of driving assistance systems.

articleTitle: An improved Vandermonde Decoding PE for Distributed Storage System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: An improved Vandermonde decoding PE for distributed storage system is proposed in this paper. The PE first give a decoding algorithm based on matrix partition and Lagrange interpolation method to split the complex matrix invention to small Vandermonde matrix's parallel parameter calculation. PE architecture is constructed by hardware working manner in Galois field of GF (2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">8</sup>). The PE is designed to work for both encoding and decoding with same module but different data and operation. The PE number is configurable to have best performance in different erasure codes “r” situations backward compatible by the control of data block distribution and Vandermonde erasure codes data selection. The hardware architecture is fully verified at RTL level and synthesized with GF 12nm technology lib and simulation results showed 60.6% to 79% speed advantages compared to Gaussian elimination.

articleTitle: Technical Research on Fire-Fighting Robotics
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Traditional ways to find and fight fires produce a great risk to firefighters because there are many unknown situations of fire. The technical research plan to design a firefighting robot to help firefighters discover risks in advance and reduce the hazards in dangerous environment. The fire-fighting robot is a type of quadcopter. Using fire-fighting drones is more efficient and decreases the risks to human life. The research would focus on introduce the vital components of firefighting drone, such as motors and propellers, and the principle of magnetic field. Motors decided whether fire-fighting drone may achieve fly and motors are located on the rotors to help rotors spin. There are four rotors in propellers and these rotors are located on the four shaft arms of drone equally. Four propeller rotors control the drone to fly up and down and change directions. A magnetic field exists in electric motor of drones, it exists by the movement of impurities or the changes in the electric field. Electric currents and magnetic fields have a close relationship. An electric current generates a magnetic field under most conditions. The different quality of motors has different influence on the drones, and it is important to protect motors of quadcopters.

articleTitle: An exploration of the application of computer music production software in music composition
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The gradual implementation of computer music production software within the current stage of music composition and traditional composition methods for integration is important for the creation of excellent musical works with unique styles and novel ideas. Based on the original composition process, we actively promote the organic integration of music production software and music composition by learning to use computer music production software and drawing on outstanding foreign works. We are constantly discovering inspirations that emerge from music creation, focusing on self-imposed requirements and quality control of music quality, and reducing the cost of music production in the traditional model. Take an objective, rational, and positive approach to computer music production. This paper takes the role of computer music production software in music composition as the research object, and combines with the excellent works at home and abroad to explore and analyze the practical problems in the application process.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Traditional Village Intelligent Evaluation Model Based on Parameterization
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Traditional villages are precious cultural heritage and non-renewable resources in China, which contain the essence of farming civilization and excellent traditional Chinese culture. Traditional villages inherit a long history and cultural skills, which is an important carrier of harmonious coexistence between rural and natural environment, the essence of rural civilization and the crystallization of culture and art. Traditional villages play a very important role in displaying local characteristic culture and protecting excellent historical buildings and local characteristic material resources. Strengthening the protection and inheritance of material and non-material elements of traditional villages, improving the living environment of traditional villages and continuing the spatial layout mode of traditional villages have gradually become the main contents of traditional village protection. This paper intends to integrate parametric design into traditional village evaluation, obtain quantitative evaluation indexes of traditional villages, establish intelligent evaluation model of traditional villages, assist traditional village evaluation in different stages, and improve the efficiency of traditional village evaluation.

articleTitle: Existential Anxiety and Transcendence in the Digital Age: Comment on “The Flick”
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Anne Baker's The Flick won the Pulitzer Prize. The form of dramatic art is used to describe the development of movies from the traditional film age to the digital age. The drama has a bland tone in terms of characters, plots and scenes. However, in this seemingly peaceful pace of social transformation, there are many social problems, especially the survival environment of marginalized people. The contradictions exposed in this common people have led us to think about the path of human existence.

articleTitle: Bat-based algorithm for intelligent regulation of traffic light eco-intersection design
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: A bat algorithm based traffic light intelligent regulation ecological intersection is designed. In order to solve the intersection vehicle congestion problem and implement reasonable and efficient traffic light control, this paper uses the Python-based VISSIM interface to realize the data interaction between the algorithm and simulation, deploys the bat algorithm on the simulation platform, and conducts simulation experiments on intersection traffic light control. The simulation results show that the signal timing algorithm based on vehicle congestion improves intersection throughput, reduces average vehicle waiting time and achieves the goal of preventing and alleviating traffic congestion compared with the traditional time-phased traffic light control method and the main road control method (ATL). Tests show that the average queue length decreased by 33.8% compared to the non-deployed algorithm, the maximum queue length decreased by 38.9%, delay decreased by 22.2%, intersection throughput increased by 14.8% and average vehicle carbon emissions decreased by 57.2%. This shows that the bat-based algorithm for intelligent signal modulation is effective in reducing traffic congestion at intersections and reducing total emissions at intersections.

articleTitle: Research on Acceleration Methods of Semi-training Color Stripping DehazeNet
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: This paper discussed the influence of the network size of the color stripping module on the dehazing performance of STCSDN through analysis and studies of the color stripping module structure in semi training color stripping DehazeNet (STCSDN). After a large number of tests, this paper verified that the performance of simplified network is close to the original network in image dehazing by removing redundant parameters and simplifying the model structure. Furthermore, the simplified network processed images faster, made the network can conduct real-time image dehazing tasks, and improved the practicality of the network.

articleTitle: Discriminant and Complementary Autoencoder Network for Multi-view Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In real-world applications, objects can be sampled by different equipment or collected from different angles, which appears a significant and challenging problem for classifying samples from these heterogeneous views. Although effectiveness is achieved, most of the previous methods could not learn a discriminant and complementary representation simultaneously. Differently, in this paper, we propose a novel model termed Discriminant and Complementary Autoencoder Network (DCAEN), which integrates discriminant information between views into a compact representation by the variant of the traditional LDA-like framework. The proposed method has the following merits: (1) our model incorporates supervised information into the common representation subspace, i.e., maximize the between-class distance and minimize the within-class distance from the inter-view and intra-view. (2) our model performs view-specific representation and common representation in a unified framework. The proposed model is solved by the stochastic gradient descent (SGD) algorithm and its performance is far better than many state-of-the-art methods, demonstrating its superiority.

articleTitle: Object Detection of Non-cooperative Target for Dual-arm Manipulation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Aiming at the task of capturing the docking ring of non-cooperative target in space, a method for object detection of non-cooperative target based on dual-arm manipulation is proposed. In addition, this paper proposed a system based on visual servo using two arms to capture the docking ring. In this system, the construction of robots formed by two UR manipulators provides services for non-cooperative satellites and meets the basic requirements of space non cooperative target acquisition task. By using Eye-in-Hand cameras and feature-based object detection algorithm, the active measurement of uncooperative spacecraft is realized. The experimental results show that Eye-in-Hand cameras and visual algorithm can be used to extract and track the target features for the non-cooperative target without hook and mark. This active visual guidance method based on features is proved to be feasible.

articleTitle: Noise and Vibration Analysis of Dry-Type Distribution Transformer in Semi-Anechoic Room
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: A transformer noise and vibration test platform in a semi-anechoic chamber environment is built in this paper. A prototype of a three-phase dry-type distribution transformer with a rated load capacity of 800 kVA is used as the test object. The noise and vibration of the core and windings under different load conditions are tested and analyzed in detail. The results can be referenced for noise and vibration control of distribution power transformers.

articleTitle: Calculation Method of Lightning Fault Rate of Overhead Lines of Ungrounded Neutral Point System Based on Characteristics of Lines and Line Lightning Corridors
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In view of the lack of accurate lightning trip out rate calculation method for overhead lines with ungrounded neutral points, this paper comprehensively considers the lightning protection configuration of transmission lines and the actual lightning activity parameters in the line corridor to carry out theoretical analysis, simulation calculation and scheme research. Firstly, based on the line account information and lightning location system monitoring data, based on the electrical geometry model to determine the impact of lightning on the line, an accurate calculation method of lightning trip out rate is proposed, and the method is used to calculate and verify the lightning trip out rate of a neutral point ungrounded line in a certain area. The results show that the lightning trip out rate calculation method can accurately calculate the lightning trip out rate of the line and the line corridor after considering the lightning characteristics of the line and the line corridor.

articleTitle: Analysis on the development status and prospect of intelligent medical
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: At present, the new-generation artificial intelligence technology is accelerating penetration into various fields including medical, education, manufacturing, transportation, finance, etc. And intelligent medical has become one of the most typical application areas. This study describes the current typical intelligent medical application scenarios, summarizes the development prospects and strategic layout of major countries in the related areas. The future development trend of intelligent medical is also discussed.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study on Low Carbon Development Model of China's Energy Economy Based on Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: This paper on the low-carbon development model at home and abroad is introduced, on the basis of further defined related concepts of low carbon development, and then on the basis of familiar with the related concepts, introduces the related carbon decomposition model, then the particle swarm optimization (pso) algorithm and BP neural network for the corresponding introduction, on the basis of related theory, multi-dimensional decomposition model of carbon productivity in our empirical study, analysis and comparison in compared with the base in different industries in various provinces the contribution values of different influence factors on the carbon productivity in our country.

articleTitle: A High-Precision Ultra-Broadband Quadrature Generation at Millimeter-Wave Frequencies
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In this paper, a high-precision ultra-broadband quadrature signal generator for millimeter-wave frequency band is proposed. The structure of cascade directional couplers is adopted, and the transmission line and equivalent lumped model are used to connect couplers. The proposed structure and the transmission line and lumped model are analyzed using the S-parameter matrix, and the corresponding theoretical formulas are provided. The simulation prototype is constructed using the 28 nm CMOS technology, so it can be integrated into a small area chip. In the frequency range of 50-150 GHz, the measured S11 and S22 of the proposed design are both less than -10 dB, while the gain mismatch is less than 1 dB, and the phase mismatch is fewer than five degrees. Compared to the traditional quarter wavelength directional coupler, the proposed generator can guarantee a high-precision quadrature output signal when the output load changes while reducing the gain and phase mismatches. In the same frequency range, the image rejection ratio is over 20 dB. The whole size of the proposed high-precision ultra-broadband quadrature coupler (HPUBC) is 260 um × 450 um. The proposed designs are verified by 3D electromagnetic simulation.

articleTitle: On-line Fault Diagnosis of Launch Vehicle Thrust Loss Based on Parameter Estimation Method
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The online diagnosis of a single thrust drop fault of the launch vehicle's four engines is studied. Based on the simplified space motion equation of the launch vehicle, the relationship between thrust and overload acceleration information is established. Then the engine thrust is identified by the least squares method of forgetting factor, and the relationship between the identified thrust and the true thrust is linearly fitted to realizes the online diagnosis of thrust drop faults. Combined with overload location strategy, the fault location of four engines was realized. The digital simulation results show that the proposed method can diagnose the engine thrust loss fault accurately and quickly, and verify the effectiveness under the wind disturbance.

articleTitle: Reaserch on zigbee-based airborne wireless pressure test network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: This paper focuses on the application requirements of wireless test network in aviation test technology, studies the design and implementation of zigbee-based wireless pressure test network system, and finally realizes the main test technology functions such as pressure wireless testing and network data aggregation by building zigbee wireless pressure sensing system.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Two-Dimensional Situation Display System for SoSs Confrontation Simulating and Evaluating System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In the construction of equipment system of systems simulation evaluation system, the two-dimensional situation display subsystem provides two-dimensional situation display, hierarchical relationship display, data recording, situation switching, situation playback and other functions for the system. In order to realize all kinds of functions of two-dimensional situation display system, the two-dimensional The system is divided into six modules according to the functional requirements on the conceptual level based on QGIS. Each module is designed and implemented in detail according to its functional requirements. The two-dimensional situation display system is designed and developed under qt4.8.6 and VS2010 environment. The system is simple in operation, rich in display styles and reliable for users, which provides real-time and rich comprehensive situation display capability for system of systems simulation and evaluation system.

articleTitle: Optimal Scheduling Mechanism for EV Charging and Discharging with Multi-Price Scales and Comprehensive Demand
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the development of electric vehicle (EV) industry, EVs have also begun to be more integrated into the distribution network, and become an important part of the distribution network. However, the uncertainty of EV user behavior and load bring great challenges to the stable operation of distribution network. In order to solve the above problem, this paper proposes an optimal scheduling mechanism for EV charging and discharging with multi-price scales and comprehensive demand. The charging and discharging prices of EV are determined by different time-of-use price strategies based on different regions, and the uncertainty of load is reduced by comprehensive demand. What's more, three quantitative indicators of satisfaction with electricity cost, network loss and load peak-valley difference are proposed to evaluate the proposed method. Then, a simulated annealing PSO algorithm is used to solve the optimization problem. Finally, the simulation results based on an IEEE 33- node system show the effectiveness of the proposed methodology.

articleTitle: Research on embedded Braille learning machine based on STM32
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: At present, China has the largest number of blind people in the world. The low level of education for visually impaired people is mainly due to the insufficient popularity of Braille. In order to help visually impaired people and special education people learn Braille, this paper designs an embedded Braille learning machine based on STM32. The Braille learning machine uses GB2312 font library, and the Braille and Chinese characters are exchanged according to the structure of the Braille. The Braille dot matrix touch module is designed, and the Braille is displayed in the dot matrix touch module according to the learning content. The user completes the Braille learning through the touch of the dot matrix touch module. In the learning process, voice broadcast and display on the LCD screen can be carried out to assist users in learning. This learning machine Braille learning machine has a high cost performance ratio, with SD card external storage can also update the font at any time. This study can better serve society and bring convenience to the visually impaired.

articleTitle: Study on Monitoring Respiratory Frequency by Smart Phone Based on Photoelectric Volume Pulse Wave Method
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Photoelectric volume pulse wave is a kind of pulse wave signal of human body detected by photoelectric means, and its acquisition method is simple. Accurate photoelectric volume pulse wave can be detected by photoelectric blood oxygen probe commonly used in family, which contains abundant physiological information, so it is of great significance to obtain respiratory frequency from photoelectric volume pulse wave. This paper designs a portable ECG and respiratory monitoring system based on Android smart phone. The system collects ECG and respiratory signals through ECG electrodes, and transmits the collected signals to Android smart phone via Bluetooth for real-time analysis, display and alarm. The collected PPG signals are filtered and de-noised by MATLAB, and the effects of illumination intensity, motion artifacts and low perfusion on PPG signals are analyzed. The system has the advantages of convenient wearing, low power consumption and high accuracy of breath detection, and can be applied to respiratory monitoring in homes and other places to meet people's daily health monitoring needs.

articleTitle: A fast algorithm for underwater image restoration based on CUDA
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Due to the severe underwater environment condition and the effects of water scattering, the images acquired by underwater optical vision system often have many problems such as low resolution, contrast and serious color shifts. Many scholars have proposed many image restoration algorithms and proved to be effective, but there is still a problem of excessive time consumption. In this regard, this article comprehensively considers the principle of dark channel underwater image imaging, combined with parallel computing related theories, and modified the serial model of the traditional underwater image restoration algorithm to be suitable for CUDA (Compute Unified Device Architecture) Parallel model. Through experimental tests, while ensuring a restoration effect similar to similar algorithms, a speed increase of about 14 times has been achieved, and the real-time restoration of underwater images is realized.

articleTitle: Intelligent Notification System for Large User Groups
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the development of communication technology, the disadvantages of traditional notification methods such as low efficiency gradually appear. With the introduction of WAP with WTLS security and its development and maintenance, more and more notification systems are using this technology. Through the analysis, design and implementation of notification system for large user groups, this paper studies how to collect and notify data without affecting the business system, and proposes a scheme of real-time data acquisition and filtering based on trigger. The middleware and application server implementation transaction management and database operation to separate CICS middleware technology based on research using UNIXC, Socket programming, SQL statements, SYBASE database technology, from the system requirements, business process, function structure, database and data structure, the input and output of the system, system testing the aspects such as design of practical significance to intelligent notification system for large user groups. Finally, the paper describes the test effect of the system in detail. 10 users send 1, 5, 10 and 20 strokes at the same time, and the completion time is 0.28, 1.09, 1.58 and 2.20 seconds, which proves that the system has practical significance.

articleTitle: Real-time prediction of urban traffic flow based on data mining
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Using data mining technology, through the analysis of historical data, the traffic flow in the next time interval can be predicted. Cluster analysis can be used to optimize the control effect of a single intersection control algorithm. Correlation analysis can be used to infer the traffic flow of related road sections to achieve real-time traffic flow guidance and information release. It is of great significance for alleviating urban traffic congestion and improving the transportation efficiency and safety of the urban road network.

articleTitle: Solar intelligent ventilation control system
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: It is not a new concept to use solar energy for natural ventilation. This paper studies the energy storage ventilation effect of solar roof ventilation system combined with phase change heat storage materials with different phase change temperatures through experiments, and also studies the daytime ventilation effect of unpowered fans. The solar energy device on the roof of the building is used to supply power to other systems such as ventilation and lighting. At the same time, it can automatically detect air quality and carry out intelligent ventilation. Through mathematical model, the influence of various factors on ventilation performance of ventilated roof is studied, and it is pointed out that the increase of chimney height and phase change temperature of heat storage material can enhance ventilation. Starting with solar energy technology to solve heating and ventilation, the residential buildings with large amount of construction and high energy consumption are taken as the research objects, which are representative and worth popularizing, and try to make a breakthrough in solar energy heat utilization.

articleTitle: Online quality checking for large-scale centralized verification based on statistical process control
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of long verification period, poor real-time performance, inaccuracy status of the traditional electric metering device, and great influence on verification and production, an on-line quality checking method suitable for large-scale centralized verification is proposed. Firstly, an anomaly judgment model is constructed based on statistical process control. Through this model, the abnormal value of the calibration data of the calibration device is judged; secondly, the upper sequence is scheduled twice by the system scheduling software; finally, the abnormal calibration device output from the model is checked real-time online by the high-precision installation standard table. The field test data show that the method can monitor the running state of the verification device in real time without affecting the actual production, and automatically initiate the on-line verification task, effectively improving the quality management efficiency and level of large-scale centralized verification pipeline.

articleTitle: Design of Crop Growing Environment Monitoring System Based on Information Fusion Theory
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In greenhouse, the growing environment of crops can be precisely controlled by the environmental monitoring system. The growth efficiency of crops can be effectively improved by the system. However, considering the energy consumption and the endurance of embedded control devices, this paper constructs a green control system for crop growth by effectively cutting the information collection network. In this paper, the temperature value is selected as an important indicator of the crops' growth environment, and the intelligent greenhouse temperature measurement model is constructed. The temperature information is analyzed and processed by the principal component analysis method (PCA) to accurately control the growth environment. This paper can provide a theoretical and practical application for cutting of the temperature collection network. The collected data at different locations of the same time is analyzed and processed under MATLAB, and finally the correlation between the number of principal components and cumulative contributing rate of principal variance (CPV) of eight different environmental indicators is obtained. Spatial location information can be used as a quantified indicator of the temperature. This paper constructs an information collection network based on PCA, which can accurately collect the overall information in the greenhouse and assist design of the effective environmental monitoring system.

Author Keywords: Cumulative Contributing rate of Principal Variance (CPV)

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of Current Detection Technology for Electricity Stealing and Omission
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of China's social economy, people's quality of life has also been greatly improved, and various household electrical equipment needs more and more electricity regardless of their application scale. In recent years, the problem of stealing electricity has become more and more apparent in hindering the development of China's power industry, which has attracted the attention of relevant enterprises, industries and departments. The purpose of this article is to greatly reduce the success rate of power theft through the improvement of power theft current detection technology, and further promote the healthy development of China's power industry. Through analysis, it is found that the traditional methods have great limitations, and the new detection technology of electric power theft and leakage current combining with the Internet of Things and other new technologies has high intelligence degree, fast speed and outstanding effect. In this paper, the application of voltage loss meter and anti-tampering devices can strengthen the power monitoring anti-theft technology. Spark mechanism is introduced into the power theft and leakage current detection model designed in this paper to build an algorithm, calculate the stolen power intelligently, and determine the evaluation index. This model can effectively monitor the user's power consumption behavior and record the illegal power consumption behavior. It can enter the instrument in real time and remotely monitor the current, voltage and power changes of the electricity meter, so as to achieve the purpose of antitheft. The experimental results show that the designed power theft current detection technology can prevent users from stealing power and reduce the economic loss of power supply companies.

articleTitle: Research on Foreground Object Recognition Tracking and Background Restoration in AIoT Era
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of artificial intelligence technology and its combination with the Internet of things, recognition processing system has become a hot field of intelligent research. Meanwhile, with the popularity of SOC sensor, complex recognition algorithms are effectively implemented and utilized. In order to explore the characteristics and application scope of each foreground object tracking algorithm, this paper establishes foreground object tracking algorithms based on three kinds of Gaussian models and two kinds of Neural network models respectively, and solves the unique "delayed ghosting" phenomenon of Gaussian model with the total variational regularization (TV regularization). In the detection problem of camera jitter, a speed up robust feature (SURF) is added to optimize the model. On this basis, the kernel density estimation (KDE) is used for automatic threshold selection, and a secondary optimized foreground object recognition and tracking model is obtained. The results show that the recognition rate of the optimized mixture of Gaussian (MOG) model is more than 90% in static recognition, the recognition and tracking accuracy of the neural network model is higher than that of the Gaussian model in dynamic background, and the fuzzy self-organizing background subtraction (F-SOBS) can greatly overcome the camera jitter problem.

articleTitle: Research on Informational Evaluation System of Group Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: This paper studies the informational level evaluation system of large group enterprises, puts forward the targeted definition and typical characteristics, establishes the basic principles, structural framework and index composition of the evaluation system, and applies it in subordinate scientific research entities. The system has universal applicability and can be used for reference by other industries.

articleTitle: Research on Image Monitoring and Management of Hot Tourism Destination Based on Data Mining Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The rapid development of big data technology not only provides a platform for netizens to create content and exchange information, but also provides an information base for tourism destinations to effectively carry out marketing. Technological innovation promotes the activeness of human-computer interaction, and tourists can know all kinds of information of destinations through network content, so as to build a perception image of tourism destinations and make final travel decisions. When there are many alternative destinations to choose from, people will compare the images of the relevant destinations, and finally choose a destination that can meet their tourism needs and psychological expectations. Tourism destination, as the object of tourism activities, will be used by tourism consumers to generate huge network content and comments by Internet media. These network data intensifies the occurrence of crisis events, which will form a small negative event into a huge scale effect. This paper attempts to reveal the spatial law of tourism destination image cognition from the basic viewpoint of geography on geographical space, so as to provide theoretical basis for tourism destination image strategy.

articleTitle: Architecture of Big Data Mining Based on Cloud Computing in the Era of Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Single layer Big Data Feature Mining (BDFM) can greatly reduce the accuracy of BDFM. In this regard, this paper proposes a feature mining method based on BDFM model in cloud computing environment. Its big data storage system layer includes multi-source information resource service layer, core technology layer, multi-source information resource platform service layer and multi-source information resource foundation layer. BDFM processing layer extracts, transforms, cleans, integrates and loads big data in the storage system layer to realize big data preprocessing. Experimental results show that the proposed method has high accuracy and low energy consumption in cloud computing environment.

articleTitle: Automatic Drawing and Visualization of Load Transfer Scheme Based on GCQGA Strategy
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The power distribution network undertakes the task of transmitting the power system to the user's “last mile”, and is directly connected to the user to ensure its safe and stable operation. In order to improve the automation level of the distribution network, according to the distribution network load transfer scheme, this paper adopts the graph calculation method, uses the Neo4j graph database technology for storage and uses the BSP graph calculation model for query operation processing. Then the quantum genetic algorithm is used for automatic mapping and visualization. The results of the calculation examples show that the method described in this article not only improves the appearance of the image, but also improves the speed of the image.

articleTitle: A Power Sharing Method for Microgrid Consisting of HAPF and VSC
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Converters play an imperative part in joining conveyed generators and directing control stream of microgrid and active distributed network (ADN). The hybrid active power filter is proposed to improve responsive control with a moo amplitude of operation’s voltage. Its control extends and characteristics are distinctive based on a routine voltage source converter (VSC). Regulation of parallel-connected HAPF and VSC in active distributed networks is examined in this work. To completely utilize the control efficiency of every sort of converter, the power output allocation calculation among these two devices is considered for reduce add up to converter rating. A control reference assurance strategy is hence proposed and inserted in various leveled control system of the active distributed network. Comes about demonstrate that converter capacity is decreased by combining HAPF and VSC. Decoupling regulation method is utilized as the essential regulation strategy to every converter. Reenactment comes about are given to appear the legitimacy of the proposed strategy.

articleTitle: A Method and System for Program Management of Security Chip Production
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: This paper analyzes the current situation and shortcomings of traditional security chip production program management, then proposes a management approach of a chip issue program management method and develope a management system based on Webservice technology. The program management method and system of chip production proposed in this paper simplifies the program management process of chip production and improves the working efficiency of chip production management.

articleTitle: Evaluation and Analysis of Industrial Technology Innovation Efficiency in Hebei Province
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: First introduce the efficiency evaluation model; secondly, establish an industrial technology innovation efficiency evaluation index system consisting of 4 input indicators and 4 output indicators; Then use the canonical correlation coefficient method to determine the lag period, use the GDP deflator to eliminate the impact of price changes, use the mean method to perform the dimensionless processing of the indicators, and use the factor analysis method to determine the weights of the indicators; finally, use the efficiency evaluation model to comprehensively measure and analyze the efficiency of industrial technology innovation in Hebei Province from 2009 to 2018, and point out the characteristics of its development. The results show that the efficiency of industrial technological innovation in Hebei Province fluctuates greatly, but the overall trend is increasing; the efficiency of technological innovation in Hebei's industry is closely related to the policy environment.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Virtual Reality Classroom of Surveying and Mapping Geographic Information Technology Based on Web GIS
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy of urban traffic flow information and improve the efficiency of traffic control, this paper studies the application of artificial intelligence technology in urban traffic. This paper mainly introduces the intelligent transportation data acquisition and control system based on artificial intelligence and neural network architecture, and points out the trend of the integration of neural network technology and intelligent transportation. This paper designs an intelligent transportation data fusion method based on neural network, and applies it to real-time acquisition, inductive dynamic control, optimal path planning and so on. In this paper, the application of geographic information system (GIS), various intelligent sensors and electronic tag positioning technology in intelligent transportation system (ITS) is described in detail.

articleTitle: A Novel Superpixels Image Segmentation Algorithm for PCBA Components
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The visual location accuracy of assembly robot is affected directly by the accuracy of image segmentation. Most traditional algorithms couldn’t meet the industrial manufacture rhythm of Printed Circuit Board Assembly (PCBA) components. As a result, this paper proposed a novel superpixels image segmentation algorithm for PCBA components. Firstly, the salient feature was extracted by Histogram-based Contrast (HC) algorithm. Then, the salience map was extracted according to the Simple Non-Iterative Clustering (SNIC) superpixels segmentation algorithm. A new method was proposed to obtain information entropy by creating a new superpixels image. Ultimately, the segmented image was obtained according to the information entropy. According to the experimental results, the F-measure, the MAE and the time were 0.7979, 0.040567 and 179.12851s respectively, showing that the proposed algorithm was better than the other six algorithms.

articleTitle: Design of Airborne Integrated Signal Conditioner Based on Switch Matrix
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: During the flight test mission, the test aircraft needs to be equipped with Switching Isolation Box, Resistance Matching Box and other test signal conditioning equipment. But nowadays, with the exception of some large test aircraft that have enough space, the test modification space for other small aircraft such as fighters is relatively small, and the existing signal conditioning equipment is large in size, also inconvenient and error-prone to configure. Therefore, in view of the above shortcomings, a stack type airborne integrated signal conditioner which integrates and modularizes from the existing signal conditioning equipment is designed. The airborne integrated signal conditioner uses analog switch matrix instead of jumper switch to design hardware, and writes software based on the designed address coding configuration protocol, so that it can configure module functions through the upper computer. The experimental results show that the designed conditioner meets the requirements of airborne test and can be used in the airborne test acquisition system. It also provides a platform for the integration and modular design of subsequent follow-up test equipment.

articleTitle: Worker’s Safety Monitoring System Based on BD/GPS Dual Mode Positioning System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: On the basis of the ordinary safety helmet, the automatic positioning function is added. The capacitance is added in the helmet to make it become a composite probe to sense the environmental electric field, and the signal is sent to zigbee module for processing. After processing, the voice integrated system will prompt to realize the purpose of preventing electric shock. The GPS motherboard is added into the helmet to realize the function of automatic positioning with I/O interface and some peripheral circuits.

articleTitle: Massive Power Grid Operational Status Data Analysis System for 3D Visualization
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Due to the high complexity and information redundancy of power grid operation data, the accuracy of power grid data analysis is poor. In order to improve the accuracy and efficiency of power grid data analysis, this paper proposes a three-dimensional visualization analysis system of power grid operation state data. Through the combination of 3D visualization technology, the configuration structure of the system is optimized. Improve the system software function, improve the system transmission algorithm, realize the accurate analysis of massive data. To ensure the fast, accurate and effective evaluation of power supply performance of each substation. Finally, the experimental results show that the developed 3D visualization analysis system of large-scale power grid operation state data has high application value and fully meets the research requirements.

articleTitle: Study on Refractive Index Distribution Measurement of Self-focusing Lens with Mach-Zehnder Interferometry
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In this paper, a Mach-Zehnder Interferometry is designed and setup to measure the refractive index of a self-focusing lens. Interference fringe patterns with different ion exchange degrees are investigated and simulated at first. Experimental interference fringe patterns are collected and analyzed by Matlab. The refractive index distribution curve of the self-focusing lens is finally obtained to easily assess the ion exchange status.

articleTitle: Simulation of Near-Surface Propagation of Powerful Electromagnetic Pulse Based on Spherical coordinates
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: It is necessary to study the propagation of the powerful electromagnetic pulse in the near-surface space because most of the electronic systems are located on the ground. Usually, it is complicated to separate the ground from the air using different coordinate systems. Based on spherical coordinates, a physical model of powerful electromagnetic pulse propagation in near-surface space is established, and the correct of algorithm is proved by an analytical example. Finally, the regularity of powerful electromagnetic pulse propagation in near-surface space is given according to Bell source waveform.

articleTitle: Analysis of Intangible Heritage Image Design and Brand Integration Design Based on Computer Graphic Design
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Cultural and creative products of historical Intangible cultural heritage are a special type of cultural and creative products. Through innovation, cultural identity and self-confidence can be enhanced, and its unique historical and cultural attributes can be excavated, thus generating rare historical value. Brand is already a well-known concept. In modern business, it is not only used to distinguish products produced by different manufacturers, but also contains the image of an enterprise and the attributes of products. With the prevalence of brand development and marketing, graphic design is increasingly becoming integrated and interactive. Based on the importance of innovation based on computer graphic design for the development of Intangible cultural heritage brand, this paper puts forward an innovative model of Intangible cultural heritage brand image design from the perspective of how to “inherit” and “innovate”. Make it gradually grow into a cultural industry with good economic development momentum, so as to realize the “productive” protection, innovation and development in the industrialized and commercialized society.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction and Application of Computer Financial Analysis System in Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: As an important part of economic and social operations, the combination of corporate financial information systems and the Internet environment is inevitable. The article aims at the construction of enterprise financial management information system under the development of the times, from the four aspects of financial management information construction status, financial management information system advantages, financial management information system design and information system software design, the construction of financial management information system is carried out It analyzes and puts forward several suggestions, which is conducive to the long-term development of the enterprise.

articleTitle: Design of Color Screen Clock Control System Based on STM32
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: For the lack of humanization of alarm clock design in the market, that is, LED display and monotonous electronic sound are widely used, a color screen alarm clock control system is proposed in this paper, which is controlled by STM32. FATFS is transplanted to improve the capacity of memory and carry out diversified data processing; the bitmaps in the SD card are read and analyzed, and then displayed on the TFT LCD screen; different music and pictures are stored in SD card to give different ringtones and change different themes to ease people's mood. On APP, the clock is adjusted via WIFI to avoid cumbersome operation caused by the use of physical keys. The alarm can be turned off by non-contact induction of infrared sensor. Finally a diversified and humanized color screen alarm clock control system is realized.

articleTitle: Analysis of Intelligent Logistics Supply Chain Management under the Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The Internet of Things technology continues to develop and popularize by the relentless march of technology, the application of the Internet of Things technology provides support for logistics supply chain management. The management level and efficiency of the supply chain determine the core competitiveness of the enterprise to a certain extent, Enterprises have higher and higher requirements for logistics supply chain management, therefore, the intelligent logistics supply chain management based on the Internet of Things emerges as the times require. At present, in the logistics supply chain of most enterprises, the speed of information transmission is very low, and information exchange errors often occur, which brings immeasurable losses to enterprises. For this reason, enterprises must strengthen the management work of intelligent logistics supply chain, should integrate the actual situation of the logistics supply chain, build the efficient logistics network with the help of the Internet of Things technology, and lay the foundation for the realization of intelligent management of the logistics supply chain. This paper analyzes and studies the management of intelligent logistics chain under the Internet of Things technology, and aims to promote the efficient development of logistics supply chain.

articleTitle: Multi-Sensor Hierarchical Fusion Estimation Based on Improved Kalman Filter and Weighted Data Fusion in Greenhouse Environment
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Greenhouse environment is complex and large, and sensor nodes are vulnerable to interference. In order to realize the real-time collection and monitoring of greenhouse humidity data and improve the reliability of wireless sensor networks (WSNs) in greenhouse, a multi-sensor hierarchical fusion estimation based on improved Kalman filter (IKF) and weighted data fusion (WDF) is proposed. In order to save energy, the sensors in the space are divided into multiple clusters, and each cluster has a certain number of sensors. The data collected by the sensors are estimated locally by using the IKF algorithm, and then the estimated data is sent to the cluster head (CH) node. The CH node further processes the data, and uses the WDF algorithm to further fuse the local estimated values. The simulation results show that the multi-sensor data fusion method can greatly reduce the amount of network data transmission and energy consumption, and improve the anti-interference ability. In addition, compared with the traditional algorithm, the proposed algorithm has better effect and accurate estimation accuracy.

articleTitle: Analysis of Computer Information Processing Technology Based on Unstructured Data
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The latest research results of complex network and information processing provide a new method and perspective for unstructured and semi-structured data mining. Information service system is centered on information content, which is represented by a large number of various documents and data. In the information service system without database, only unstructured data exists. Most information resources are no longer just structured data, but provided to users in various unstructured forms. In order to dig up the data wealth, it is necessary to create an efficient, convenient and safe storage platform with large capacity, so as to store these huge data effectively. In the unstructured information processing platform, users and resources are often in dynamic changes, and users may need to be dynamically authorized in different collaborative stages. This paper will take unstructured data as the object, study the related technologies of information processing, and integrate it into the complex network construction, and study how to build multi-type networks to make full use of unstructured data.

articleTitle: Research on hydrogen-light ship power system
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Hydrogen fuel cell and photovoltaic panel are ideal energy devices. If they are to be used in ships, it is necessary to select and simulate the relevant parameters, and calculate and match the power output. In this paper, aiming at the aspects of power matching, parameter selection and design synthesis of hydrogen light ship, which are less studied in China and relatively weak in related technology, taking safety and real ship realizability as the premise of system design, the theoretical value calculation and model establishment are carried out, the feasibility of design is determined by theoretical calculation, and the Simulink is constructed according to the output characteristics of the actual module Finally, through simulation analysis, the output characteristic curve meets the requirements of the actual ship. On this basis, a set of marine hydrogen photodynamic system is designed according to the engineering standards, in order to make some technical breakthroughs in the four aspects of marine use, integration, safety and efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on Flat Design Based on UI Design
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: This article mainly analyzes the popular trend of flat and simple design in UI design, and understands how flat design can contribute to creating a better user experience by analyzing the principles of flat design aesthetics. This article expounds the author's understanding of the flat design style in terms of the connotation, advantage and disadvantages, design methods and the ultimate goal of UI design. Nowadays, almost all UI design works present a simple and flat design style. This frenzy has also gradually affected other design fields. This article will discuss the concepts, roots, design principles and techniques of flat design, and explore its future development trends.

articleTitle: Influence of Atmospheric Transmittance on Infrared Temperature Measurement Accuracy
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Infrared temperature measurement has a wide range and more applications, due to infrared temperature measurement does not need to contact with the object under test. However, the accuracy of infrared temperature measurement is difficult to reach a satisfactory degree, which limits the development and application of infrared temperature measurement method. This study explores how the atmospheric transmittance affects the temperature measurement accuracy of infrared thermal imager. Based on the composition of atmosphere, the major reason affecting atmospheric transmittance have been found. Meanwhile, according to the influence of water vapor and carbon dioxide absorption, aerosol, atmospheric molecule and other suspended particles, attenuation of atmospheric transmittance caused by complex weather conditions, such as rain and snow. Atmospheric transmission model is proposed, and the theoretical formula for calculating atmospheric transmittance is obtained.

articleTitle: Research on Recognition Technology of Fruit based on Simulated Annealing Algorithm and Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Using image recognition technology can greatly improve the efficiency of fruit automatic grading. This paper proposes a fruit grading algorithm based on simulated annealing algorithm and neural network. When the BP neural network model is used to attain the optimal solution, it is easy to fall into the local optimal solution. In order to solve this problem, the simulated annealing algorithm is introduced to expand the weight of updated space of the network. In this paper, apple is selected as the research object. Firstly, the feature model for Apple classification is established, and then the corresponding BP neural network model is established. Finally, the simulated annealing algorithm is used to optimize the neural network algorithm. Compared with the common BP neural network algorithm and RBF neural network algorithm, this algorithm has better recognition efficiency.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of College Students' Physical Health Data Analysis System Based on Multiple Computing Big Data
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the promotion of testing work over the years, colleges and universities have accumulated a large number of data including students' basic information and physical fitness test results. In order to facilitate the analysis of students' physical health test data, the data mining technology is applied in it. FP growth algorithm is used to process the data of students' physical health test. Six universities are selected as the research objects. The minimum support and minimum confidence are set to find association rules. According to the association rules, this paper analyzes the students' physique, so as to formulate relevant measures to improve the physique of Chinese college students. The experimental results show that the method has a certain reference value for the design of College Students' physical health data analysis system.

articleTitle: Research on the System Architecture of People-oriented Smart Community
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: On the basis of combing the existing concept and practice of smart community, this study puts forward the concept construction of people-oriented smart community, and discusses its model, structure and connotation. The aim is to realize the intelligentization of community planning, management and service by means of the new generation information technology such as Internet of Things, cloud computing and mobile Internet, and to form an efficient, sustainable and cohesive community and improve the quality of life of residents through innovative means.

articleTitle: Research on a Real-time Computer Network Trend Analysis Algorithm Based on Dynamic Data Flow under the Background of Big Data
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the continuous development of information technology, the Internet technology and computing technology are constantly improving and developing, and the demand of users is constantly increasing in this process, so the network specification is particularly important in this context. Traditional behavior identity is mostly based on a static model, which has a strong dependence on sample eigenvalues, but lacks flexibility and adaptability to individual users' behavior habits. In this paper, the data stream is segmented and fitted based on the total least square method, and the traditional curve analysis algorithm and online data segmentation are combined and improved. The variable sliding window algorithm is used to realize the reasonable segmentation of the data stream and improve the accuracy of trend analysis. Experimental results show that the algorithm has high recognition rate and good adaptability to users.

articleTitle: Testability modeling and analysis of layered system based on multi signal flow graph
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In order to analyze the testability of hierarchical system, a testability modeling and analysis method based on multi signal flow graph model is proposed. In this method, the hierarchical structure model of hierarchical system is established by using the multi signal flow graph model. When the testability analysis is carried out, the correlation model method is used to analyze the testability of the top-level model. When the hierarchical module cannot be distinguished from other modules Finally, a hierarchical filter amplifier circuit is used to verify the proposed method. The experimental results show that the proposed method is effective for time-sharing The testability modeling and analysis of layered system is effective, which can make effective diagnosis strategy for layered system.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation of a New Detent Catch Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The key questions to be considered in design of the detent catch mechanism are expatiated. Under limited condition, the applied force when rocket projectile retreating and locking force of the mechanism are analysed. In order to validate the use performance, the launching momentum analysis of the operation course of the mechanism is done with finite element software, the fracture time and the shear force when the resisting shear pin is cut to fracture is ascertained, which set base for the study of launch dynamics of rocket launcher's inner trajectory and the analysis of initial disturbance.

articleTitle: Research on Power Grid Planning Based on Vicious Data
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Since entering the new century, the traditional electric power industry has been unable to meet the increasing demand for electricity. With the advent of the information age, the electric power industry is facing many new problems and challenges. my country closely follows the trend of the times and is in line with international standards. In May 2009, it put forward the strategic requirements for building a smart grid with Chinese characteristics. The plan is a three-stage development. In 2020, the State Grid Corporation of China will build a comprehensive and strong smart grid. Countries such as Europe and the United States have also put forward their own smart grid development and requirements, which shows that smart grid technology is the development trend and direction of future power grids. And the research on Power Grid Planning Based on Vicious Data need to be started.

articleTitle: Robust LAD Based Occluded Face Recognition using a Support Map
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Recently, face recognition has been widely studied. Many works use different fidelity terms to gain better robust performance in the case of occlusion. Most of them use least-squares-based estimation as the fidelity term, which is not far from the real situation especially under the occlusions. Moreover, these methods ignore the knowledge that occlusion has local spatial continuity. To get the more robust result, this paper proposes a novel method, namely robust least-sum of absolute deviations (RLAD) based occluded face recognition using a support map. Although LAD regression is more robust than LS regression, we propose a support map as the weight vector to gain robustness. The RLAD alternatively updates the support map and the representation code. Then, the classification stage is present based on the support map and the representation code. Extensive experiments on the Extended Yale B public face database demonstrate the effectiveness and robustness of the RLAD in face recognition against occlusion.

articleTitle: Research on Fatigue Damage of Hydrogenerator Unit Head Cover Connecting Bolts Based on Time-Frequency Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of fatigue damage caused by long-term alternating loads on the connecting bolts of hydrogenerator unit head cover, the concept of power density is introduced in the paper. Combined with the short-time Fourier transform, a method for calculating the fatigue damage of the head cover bolts based on the combination of power density theory and time-frequency analysis is proposed to study the influence of the coupling effect of loading frequency and variable amplitude load on the fatigue damage of roof connecting bolts. Based on the raw data collected by the monitoring system for the head cover bolts of a hydrogenerator unit in an actual operating hydropower station, the proposed method is used to calculate the bolt fatigue damage. Timefrequency analysis method based on power density can effectively calculate bolt fatigue damage. For the stress data of the measured power station within 300s, the fatigue damage is calculated is 2.8208×10-7, this study method and result can provide a reference for fatigue damage calculation of hydraulic turbine head cover bolts.

articleTitle: Research on Communication Power of Self-media Hot Articles in Colleges and Universities from Big Data Perspective : —Analysis of the hottest tweets of the year based on the WeChat public number of the Communist Youth League in 1375 colleges and universities in China
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: This paper takes the annual hottest tweets of the Communist Youth League WeChat public number in 2018 as a sample, using content classification, formal classification, school region, school level, issue month, issue time as explanatory variables. Through data set statistics, this paper analyzes the relationship between explanatory variables and the transmission power of explained variables.

Author Keywords: the communication power of the Communist Youth League

articleTitle: LTE-R Communication System Safety Performance Analysis Based on Cloud Theory and Combined Weighting
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: To solve the problem of single evaluation method of LTE-R communication system safety performance, a cloud theory and combined weighting method was proposed. Firstly, the index system of LTE-Railway (LTE-R) communication system was established. Secondly, combining with the dynamic weighting method, the subjective & objective weighting values of the evaluation system calculated by 3-scale AHP and CRITIC were fused. Thirdly, by determining the cloud digital characteristics of the comprehensive cloud theory, the cloud evaluation system was established, and then the cloud parameters of each layer of the evaluation system were calculated from bottom to top by the reverse cloud theory. An example showed that the method was feasible and effective.

articleTitle: Amplitude Comparison Protection Scheme Including DG Access Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Distributed power access to the distribution network changes the topology and fault characteristics of the traditional radial distribution network, and has a great impact on the traditional current protection, making some traditional criteria no longer suitable. According to the fault analysis of the phase-to-phase short-circuit, it can be concluded that the current amplitudes at both ends of the line are not equal when a fault occurs. A new type of integrated protection scheme for distributed power access to the distribution network is proposed. The protection scheme draws on the scalar product braking form of the current differential protection and has been improved. The protection criterion is formed by using the split-phase full current amplitude and the positive sequence fault component current amplitude at both ends of the line to improve the protection sensitivity. Through theoretical analysis and simulation of the comprehensive protection scheme, the practicability and rationality of the protection scheme can be obtained.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Intelligent Car based on Machine Vision
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of science and technology, the development of Internet of Things technology, machine vision technology and driverless technology is increasingly mature. The intelligent car in this design research is based on OpenCV's machine vision, which can realize automatic driving, image recognition, background monitoring, environmental monitoring and other functions. Background data server is developed based on the open source framework Springboot, which can obtain real-time car monitoring video and various monitoring data.

articleTitle: Study on City Terminals Planning and Layout
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: A city terminal is the transit station of airport and city traffic, which is closely related to the economic level of a city. Based on the influencing factors, layout principles, layout methods, location selection and other aspects of city terminal construction, this paper puts forward a new layout method of city terminals, which is applied to the layout of city terminal building of Shenzhen Airport in practice, and provides reference for relevant study in this field.

articleTitle: Research on Computer Network Information Security Problems and Prevention Based on Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the continuous improvement of China's scientific and technological level, computer network has become an indispensable part of people's daily life. It can not only effectively improve the efficiency of production and life, and shorten the distance between people, but also further promote the speed of China's social and economic development, which has a positive impact on the realization of China's modernization. Under the new information security demand environment at present, we should pay attention to the related information security work and formulate effective security measures and strategies. In order to effectively prevent these information security problems, people should actively adopt firewall technology, encryption technology, network access control technology and network virus prevention technology for effective protection. This paper analyzes the security problems in the application of wireless sensor networks and explores the mechanism of defending information security, hoping to strengthen the security and stability of wireless sensor networks through effective measures, so that people can better enjoy the convenience brought by the network age.

articleTitle: Research on Method of High Reliability of Crossing Security Zone for Electrical Isolation Devices
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The large-scale application of new technologies such as cloud computing in power supply companies makes the mode of traditional power security zones cannot efficiently support the existing business. A simplified interaction protocol of crossing security zones is proposed based on the TCP, which encapsulate the file transfer protocol in the base of isolation devices. It unifies the exchange interface between the production & control zone and the management & information zone, and accord with the transmission modes of request/reply and subscription/publication. Multi-channel data transmission in isolation devices is implemented by multi-thread technology. It established data confirmation mechanism by priority control in crossing security zones. It implemented high reliability of transmission between forward & reverse isolation devices. Finally, it gives process and results of verification through comparing. The method helps to improve the quality of data sharing for application systems crossing different security zones.

articleTitle: Parameter difference between two types network of urban streets
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: We investigated 26 urban street in four cities, the results show that a parameter of the cumulative density distribution function based on the centricity of the medium can be used to distinguish the planned urban street network from the self-organized urban street network.

articleTitle: Discussion on Big Data Processing Mode of Test Vessel Based on Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In order to build a reasonable cloud computing model architecture of marine comprehensive test vessel, this paper integrates the complex and heterogeneous big data, and analyzes the feasibility of the application of big data processing mode of marine test vessel. This paper proposes an optimized cloud data platform architecture, which can meet the daily data analysis of marine comprehensive test vessel. Finally, combined with practical application, this paper verifies the feasibility The effectiveness of the method improves the information processing efficiency of the ocean test vessel.

articleTitle: Communication Design in a System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Taking a system as an example, in this paper, the operating principle of the communication system in a certain system was introduce, on the basis of the analysis of the characteristics and difficulties of the communication system in the fire control system, the dual DSP architecture system solution which takes high-speed digital processing chip TMS320LF28335 as the main body was proposed, furthermore, the system hardware design and software flow were given, the system task allocation to the two DSP control units and their peripheral interfaces were discussed in detail, and the cooperative work process of two DSP control units in a communication system was analyzed. Finally, the results of the system principle prototype after bench test were given in this paper, the test results show that the performance and working condition control of the system meet the design requirements.

articleTitle: A Novel Fault Diagnosis of Bearing Approach using a Hybrid of Empirical Mode Decomposition and Discrete Wavelet Transform
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: To ensure a flawless working of a machine, fault diagnosis and condition monitoring is very critical. Talking about automobile industry, aviation industry, or robotics, mechanical inspection is essential. Bearing being one of the most important components in almost every mechanical system from spindle of a lathe to the wheel of an aircraft. So, health management of a bearing needs more attention than any other mechanical component. In this paper, a novel approach for signal processing using a hybrid of discrete wavelet transform (DWT) and empirical mode decomposition (EMD), for fault diagnosis of bearing has been proposed. In the first step, DWT is used to split the raw vibration signal into certain frequency sub-bands, and in the next step EMD is used to decompose the selected frequency band into a number of intrinsic mode functions (IMFs) and a residue. Afterwards, feature ranking and selection was performed using One-way ANOVA and Kruskal Wallis in MATLAB. Then for classification unit, support vector machine (SVM) and artificial neural network (ANN), techniques have been adopted. The results using the proposed strategy were quite satisfying. This concept can be used in future to inspect and predict a range of different faults including gear and rotor.

articleTitle: Detection of Human Behavioral Events Combining Perceptual Causality
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
