abstract: In this paper, we propose a computational model of human behavior events analysis that integrates perceptual causality. Design and establish a causal rule representation method based on default logic, which provides a concise syntax and semantic formal tool for potential causality. Through the analysis of the internal structure of the event, the technical framework of causality with the smallest action unit as the entity is established, which makes the traditional different entities, objects, events, states and actions naturally interrelated. By establishing the perceptual causal relationship between human goals and objects, events, reasoning the intention of human goals, and predicting their behavior, it can effectively solve the problem of human action occlusion and action error detection. The effectiveness of this method is evaluated on a new video dataset.

articleTitle: Cardiovascular Disease Diagnosis Based on Stacking Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Machine learning algorithms are widely used in the medical field. In the field of cardiovascular disease research, machine learning can be used for assisted diagnosis. In this paper, a model was built to use stacking technology to fuse logistic regression, support vector machine and BP neural network. Then cardiovascular disease dataset was used to solve the problem of how to improve the accuracy of cardiovascular disease diagnosis and shorten the diagnosis time. In the data collection, half of the patients were ill, and half were not. Most of them were male. Patients `ages, heights and weights were not the same. They were low in cholesterol and glucose, had no smoking or drinking habits, and most of them had physical labor. The model accuracy and F1 score trained with stacking technology are the highest, with a large increase. When training the model, we could get an auxiliary diagnostic accuracy higher than that of machine learning model using a certain algorithm alone without too many adjustments and feature selection. Its results are more accurate, greatly improving the accuracy of doctors in clinical diagnosis, and shortening the diagnostic time, so that patients can be treated in time.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Intelligent Terminal Network Performance and Problem Location Method Based on User Perception
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of mobile Internet services, how to evaluate and enhance user perception is an urgent problem to be solved. Nowadays, smart phones have been popularized in an all-round way, but the traditional wireless network optimization lacks the link of optimization for user terminals. Based on user perception, this paper puts forward a packet capture analysis technology on the terminal, which can realize the linkage analysis of terminal wireless signaling and signaling. Through one-click repair technology, the self-adaptation of expert solution library, system solution library, internet repair library and driver library on the background server side with intelligent terminal is realized, and the one-click repair of the interaction between terminal and network is completed. The flat design can flexibly expand the data type of call ticket to meet different business requirements.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Online Test System of Linear Algebra Based on Mathematical Modeling
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Linear algebra is a professional basic course for science and engineering students in colleges and universities. This course focuses on discussing the linear theory of finite dimensional space, which is highly logical and abstract. Examination is an important way and means to urge students to study consciously and check the effects of teaching and learning. It is also an effective guiding measure for learning behavior, and it is also a method often used to distinguish, discover and select talents. It is an important measure to integrate the idea of mathematical modeling into the reform of mathematics teaching in colleges and universities. Based on the idea of mathematical modeling, this paper calculates the assessment parameters by MCMC method, and realizes the accurate test of online learning achievement. Experimental results show that user satisfaction and performance are high.

articleTitle: Crowd Dynamics Analysis Using a Bio-inspired Model
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: During emergency situations in buildings (e.g., fire at Grenfell Tower), rapid and safe evacuation is crucial for saving lives of people. Computer models allow determining evacuation times for various emergency conditions. These models offer insights into potential difficulties and offer possible solutions to evacuation challenges (e.g., low visibility, high anxiety, low environmental familiarity) in a short time and at low cost. This project focuses on defining the optimal location of guidance signs on evacuation route networks in building using optimisation and simulation with the aim of avoiding congestion. A bio-inspired optimization is introduced into the Social Force Model in order to avoid high density areas while following the fastest route.

articleTitle: Corona Aging of Polyimide Films at Different Atmospheric Relative Humidity
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In order to investigate the effect of atmospheric relative humidity (RH) on corona discharge aging of polyimide (PI) films, a tracing monitoring was performed on the different aging phases of PI film at different RH values. The experiments on discharge activities, dielectric properties and surface morphologies were carried out in this work. It revealed that as RH below 69% both discharge quantity and discharge frequency experienced rapid growth stage, stationary stage and secondary development stage, but as RH exceeds 84%, both of them increased linearly with time. Moisture content rate (Δwt%) increased significantly at the beginning of the corona aging and leveled off at stationary and secondary development stages; As RH reached 84%, Δwt% almost linearly increased along with the aging time; Moreover, it indicated that the electrothermal surface damage caused by corona discharge was deemed as the main cause of the rapid decrease of surface resistivity (ρs). With the corona erosion, water gradually entered the film, eventually leading to the sharp decrease of ρν till breakdown.

articleTitle: Wrist Pulse Detector with Pneumatic Compression
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Traditional Chinese medicine generally detects the pulse change rule of the patient to diagnose the disease suffered by the patient. Changes in blood flow will cause changes in pulse vibration. As blood flow runs through the whole body, the occurrence of diseases will lead to pulse disorder. Sometimes diseases have not yet occurred, but doctors can predict diseases through pulse changes, so pulse sensing is very important to traditional Chinese medicine. At present, the existing pulse detectors have various defects. The medical detectors are too large in volume, complex in detection methods, high in cost, unstable in pneumatic compression, inaccurate in measurement results of portable equipment, randomness in pulse collection points, and no pneumatic compression. In this study, a wrist pulse detector with pneumatic compression was created by improving the defects of medical and portable pulse detectors. This detector is equipped with the pneumatic compression system, so it can better fix the wrist position and collect pulse information. At the same time, it is portable and convenient for doctors to carry, thus serving some people with mobility difficulties. Moreover, this detector has extremely low cost and is suitable for household and medical use. The hand of the tested person is placed in the cylinder, and the tested person uses the pneumatic pump to pressurize the airbag to fix and detect. Finally, the display screen will display the pulse signal waveform diagram of the tested person, so as to facilitate doctors to observe abnormal pulse.

articleTitle: Cloud-Side Collaboration 5g Paas Collaborative Management and Control Platform Technology Based on Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) was proposed in 1995, and its appearance has attracted the attention and research of many scholars. This algorithm is different from traditional optimization algorithms. It is actually a new type of group optimization algorithm. Its main advantages are simple structure, few parameters, fast particle convergence and strong optimization ability. With the rise of cloud computing technology, software development, delivery, development and usage models have undergone tremendous changes. Software developers no longer use traditional design and development models, and software development models based on service composition technology have become a new trend. Developers do not need to be interested in implementing many basic network application technologies when delivering software, but should only focus on implementing business logic. Delivering the business logic of the application to the cloud-based network support platform with the idea of platform as a service can make it an expanding network application for large-scale users. We call this platform PaaS cloud computing platform. Scalability and low rental costs allow software providers to easily implement applications, thereby greatly reducing workload and maintenance. Users no longer need to purchase or develop applications, but can customize and use the software as a service model. Use software delivered to the platform to meet individual needs. Although the research on collaborative 5G PaaS platform management and control platform technology is constantly evolving, Cui still has many shortcomings. In order to solve the problem of the lack of a unified standard platform in the cloud computing environment, this paper uses the particle weight method and the discrete particle algorithm to study the collaborative 5G PaaS collaborative management control platform. Through the method in this paper, it can be concluded that the cloud-side collaborative 5G PaaS collaborative management platform technology based on particle swarm algorithm is 24% faster than the traditional method.

Author Keywords: Paas Collaborative Management and Control Platform

articleTitle: An RPi-based Smart Track Finding Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Along with the popularization and progress of machine learning, more and more AI-based applications have emerged, in which unmanned driving is an important sector. However, due to complex function requirements and large amount of data to process during solution, unmanned driving usually requires significant hardware costs. The author used RPi as the basic platform, 3D Additive Manufacturing and common processing methods for model making, convolutional neural network (CNN) algorithm, as well as Keras and Tensflow modules, to make an unmanned smart track finding vehicle that can be applied to multiple scenarios.

articleTitle: Research on Photovoltaic Power Generation Based on Multi-Channel PID
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In order to improve the utilization efficiency of solar energy, based on the in-depth study of the characteristics of solar energy, a control scheme based on daily motion trajectory was designed. In this scheme, single chip microcomputer is used as the controller to realize the output of SPWM waveform, and the compound PID with multiplexing selection is used to control the Angle of solar panel, so as to achieve the effect of fast and sensitive tracking of solar illumination. Through the angle sensor, on-line monitoring of the angle data of the solar panel, according to the intelligent control optimization algorithm, combined with single-chip microcomputer control technology, a more optimized control scheme is proposed. The experimental data show that the design effect is good and the expected control goal is achieved.

articleTitle: Research on Optimization of University Ideology Education Network Platform Based on New Media Platform
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In the ideology education of students, universities should give full play to the role of new media, effectively avoid its risks, improve the education system and strengthen team building, so as to make ideology education achieve practical results. With the emergence of new media, there are many uncertain factors in ideology education in universities, among which there are both opportunities and challenges. Compared with traditional media, the amount of information disseminated by new media is more huge and difficult to control, resulting in mixed information. As successors in the new era, college students shoulder the important mission of serving the motherland. In order to meet the requirements of the continuous development of ideology education in universities under the background of new media, this paper attempts to break through the thinking mode of ideology education in universities by theoretical analysis, based on the ideological state of university students and the objective reality of Internet development, and guided by the connotation of ideology education in universities, so as to construct a new mode of ideology education platform in universities with new media.

articleTitle: Comparison on Multiple Signal Analysis Method in Transformer Core Looseness Fault
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The core looseness fault is an important part of transformer fault. The state of the core can be obtained by analyzing the vibration signal. Vibration analysis method has been used in transformer condition monitoring and fault diagnosis for many years, while different methods produce different results. In order to select the correct method in engineering application, five kinds of joint time-frequency analysis methods, such as short-time Fourier transform, Wigner-Ville distribution, S transform, wavelet transform and empirical mode decomposition are compared, and the advantages and disadvantages of these methods for dealing with the vibration signal of transformer core are analyzed in this paper. It indicates that wavelet transform and empirical mode decomposition have more advantages in the diagnosis of core looseness fault. The conclusions have referential significance for the diagnosis of transformer faults in engineering.

articleTitle: Analysis of Online Learning Behavior Characteristics and Influencing Factors Based on Link Prediction
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the continuous development of information, people's access to information is gradually diversified and convenient, which also leads to the fast speed of knowledge update and provides unlimited possibilities for lifelong learning. In the digital learning environment, the learning resources faced by learners far exceed the digital education resources in the campus environment, and are more dazzling. However, as a new thing, online learning still has many problems and shortcomings. The most prominent problem in online learning is the poor interactivity of the learning platform, and it is difficult for learners to answer a series of questions in the learning process in time, which directly leads to a certain gap in the effect of online learning compared with face-to-face teaching. This paper analyzes various learning behavior data of learners on the online teaching platform, finds out or discovers the characteristics and implementation practice of learners' online learning behavior based on link prediction method, and puts forward learning support service strategies and suggestions, providing data support and useful reference for teaching quality evaluation, monitoring and teaching reform.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of 5G MEC Based on Support Vector Machine in Cloud Side Cooperative Construction of Security Special Video Cloud Management System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Security industry is a sunrise industry. Video surveillance system is a subsystem of security system and an important part of technical defense. IT has matured with the development of IT technologies such as multimedia technology, codec technology and network technology. Nowadays, most of the video analysis and management processes are manual or semi-automatic, which is difficult to meet the real-time requirements, and the utilization rate of video information is low. In this paper, the architecture of mobile edge computing technology is analyzed, and a cascaded two-tier support vector machine is designed. The first tier uses two-class support vector machine to find local features in test images, and the second tier uses multi-class support vector machine to find the categories of images. Using the advantages of cloud computing architecture, it provides users with scalable, flexible and centrally integrated video management, video access and video storage services.

articleTitle: The Design of City Brand Visual Image Recognition System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Thanks to the city brand strategy, more and more countries and cities carry out self marketing. In this regard, branding urban space is a key subdivision to achieve a place's publicity. Therefore, from the perspective of urban design, this paper discusses the factors and indicators affecting the branding of urban conventional space. From the perspective of city brand, through the research of relevant resources, we find out the most important factors that affect the brand of urban space, and give a table including the influencing factors and indicators of brand urban space. The results are a basic chart that can be used to compare urban space with major criteria. The conclusion reveals a fact: compared with other brand urban space, how many factors are included in a selected urban space. Regional cultural differences directly lead to the characteristics of urban development. The unique regional culture is the precious wealth of city brand image design, which has practical significance for creating characteristic city brand. From the perspective of regional culture, this paper discusses the positioning of city brand image, urban CI design, city brand image communication and management, hoping to promote urban development with the influence of city brand. The design of city brand image should not blindly "create" personality, but should follow the law of regional culture development and "seek roots" from the deep structure of regional culture and obtain enlightenment. This is the only way to shape the city brand image.

articleTitle: Design of an Intelligent Floor Placing Machine
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In view of the problems that the floor laying work in the house is mainly done by manpower, which consumes a lot of labor and takes a long time, we designed an all-in-one floor laying machine. The intelligent floor laying machine is mainly composed of two parts: cement sprinkling device and floor laying device, which can realize the basic functions of automatically spreading cement and automatically finishing the floor laying work, and can save time and efficiently finish the floor laying work in the whole house or workshop. After being put into production, it can save the company's consumption cost, improve workers' work efficiency and bring significant economic benefits.

articleTitle: Research on Fault Diagnosis Based on Virtual Prototype Technology of Mechanical System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The increasing complexity of the mechanical system makes it difficult for the corresponding physical prototype to diagnose and distinguish the faults. Therefore, the simulation research of virtual prototype is needed before the physical prototype experiment. Virtual prototype technology is a technology that uses computer technology, information technology and other technologies to carry out mathematical modeling of the corresponding mechanical system physical machine. This paper will take a mechanical system gearbox as the modeling object based on Virtual Prototype Technology for modeling analysis. Through the mathematical modeling of the gearbox, the typical fault features of the gearbox are extracted. Through the simulation of the actual working process of the gearbox, the corresponding load and constraints are imposed on the gearbox, and the corresponding collision parameters are selected to realize the dynamic simulation of the gearbox and observe its corresponding working conditions. Finally, the corresponding simulation results are applied to the actual work. The simulation results show that the virtual prototype technology is conducive to the early diagnosis and prevention of mechanical system faults, and has good industrial application value.

articleTitle: Emerging trends in respiratory protective equipment: a scientometric analysis in CiteSpace
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In this paper, 1030 pieces of literature about respiratory protective equipment collected from the core database Of Web Of Science (WOS) from 2000 to 2020 were summarized, analyzed and studied, and the scientific knowledge map Of respiratory protective equipment was drawn with the help Of information visualization software CiteSpace. By using CiteSpace software to make a visual analysis of the sample literature, draw the map of keyword cluster, time zone, emerging word detection, author co-citation, etc., the evolution path of respiratory protective equipment is combed, the focus of the development of respiratory protective equipment is analyzed, and the development frontier of respiratory protective equipment is predicted.

articleTitle: Research on Emotional Feature Analysis and Recognition in Speech Signal Based on Feature Analysis Modeling
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Human speech contains not only the information of characters and symbols, but also the information of people's feelings and emotions. The purpose of emotional computing is to endow computers with the ability to observe, understand and generate various emotional features like human beings, so that computers can interact naturally, kindly and vividly like human beings, and have the same emotional intelligence as human beings. How to personify the computer and provide the most comfortable dialogue environment for the dialogue objects adaptively has become the development goal of the next generation computer. It is of great significance in theory and application to analyze and process the emotional features in speech signals, and to judge and simulate the emotions and sorrows of speakers. In this paper, the general framework of speech emotion recognition system is analyzed, the commonly used methods of feature parameter extraction and validity analysis are introduced, and the distribution law of emotion features of different emotion speech signals is summarized, which provides practical theoretical data for emotion signal processing and recognition.

articleTitle: Genetic Algorithm Based optimization of Construction Site Layout of Prefabricated Buildings
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Taking the prefabricated building construction site layout as the research object, combined with the concept of green construction, the BIM model of prefabricated building construction site layout is constructed by using the parametric modeling method based on genetic algorithm. According to the specific requirements of the prefabricated building construction site, considering the use of recycled concrete aggregate, and making full use of the characteristics of BIM model, the constraints and influencing factors of prefabricated building construction site layout are transformed into quantifiable data. Based on the quantifiable data, the multi-objective function is constructed, and different layout schemes are obtained by using genetic algorithm. Then, according to the results obtained, the fuzzy selection method is used to compare and select the schemes, and the best scheme for the construction site layout of prefabricated buildings is finally determined. The experimental results show that the scheme is efficient and feasible, and can meet the construction technical requirements.

articleTitle: Critical Discourse Analysis and Research Based on Ideological Internet Buzzwords
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: As a "national language" created by netizens collectively, Internet buzzwords are a symbolic epitome of social changes, an essential part of current Internet media culture, and an essential window for observing the dynamics of public thoughts, emotions and understanding changes in public social opinion. When onlookers and expression have become the way for the masses to live on the Internet, complex textual expressions have been discarded and replaced by highly condensed expressions. Such word-making methods are consistent with the requirements of language economics. Internet buzzwords are the product of netizens' language recreation. The essence of Internet buzzwords is a kind of public discourse that appears in the form of entertainment. It expresses netizens' concern about reality, builds up the social identity and discourse consensus of the netizens, and measures the discourse between official public opinion and private-public opinion. The governance of Internet buzzwords is a new subject of Internet new media governance.
